1.zh: 提阿非罗大人哪，有好些人提笔作书，述说在我们中间所成就的事，是照传道的人从起初亲眼看见又传给我们的。
1.en: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,
even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

1.zh: 这些事我既从起头都详细考察了，就定意要按着次序写给你，
1.en: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

1.zh: 使你知道所学之道都是确实的。
1.en: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

1.zh: 当犹太王希律的时候，亚比雅班里有一个祭司，名叫撒迦利亚；他妻子是亚伦的后人，名叫伊利莎白。
1.en: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

1.zh: 他们二人在　神面前都是义人，遵行主的一切诫命礼仪，没有可指摘的，
1.en: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

1.zh: 只是没有孩子；因为伊利莎白不生育，两个人又年纪老迈了。
1.en: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

1.zh: 撒迦利亚按班次在　神面前供祭司的职分，
1.en: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

1.zh: 照祭司的规矩掣签，得进主殿烧香。
1.en: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

1.zh: 烧香的时候，众百姓在外面祷告。
1.en: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

1.zh: 有主的使者站在香坛的右边，向他显现。
1.en: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

1.zh: 撒迦利亚看见，就惊慌害怕。
1.en: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

1.zh: 天使对他说：「撒迦利亚，不要害怕，因为你的祈祷已经被听见了。你的妻子伊利莎白要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫约翰。
1.en: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

1.zh: 你必欢喜快乐；有许多人因他出世，也必喜乐。
1.en: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

1.zh: 他在主面前将要为大，淡酒浓酒都不喝，从母腹里就被圣灵充满了。
1.en: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

1.zh: 他要使许多以色列人回转，归于主—他们的　神。
1.en: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

1.zh: 他必有以利亚的心志能力，行在主的前面，叫为父的心转向儿女，叫悖逆的人转从义人的智慧，又为主预备合用的百姓。」
1.en: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

1.zh: 撒迦利亚对天使说：「我凭着什么可知道这事呢？我已经老了，我的妻子也年纪老迈了。」
1.en: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

1.zh: 天使回答说：「我是站在　神面前的加百列，奉差而来对你说话，将这好信息报给你。
1.en: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

1.zh: 到了时候，这话必然应验；只因你不信，你必哑巴，不能说话，直到这事成就的日子。」
1.en: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

1.zh: 百姓等候撒迦利亚，诧异他许久在殿里。
1.en: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

1.zh: 及至他出来，不能和他们说话，他们就知道他在殿里见了异象；因为他直向他们打手式，竟成了哑巴。
1.en: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

1.zh: 他供职的日子已满，就回家去了。
1.en: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

1.zh: 这些日子以后，他的妻子伊利莎白怀了孕，就隐藏了五个月，
1.en: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

1.zh: 说：「主在眷顾我的日子，这样看待我，要把我在人间的羞耻除掉。」
1.en: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

1.zh: 到了第六个月，天使加百列奉　神的差遣往加利利的一座城去（这城名叫拿撒勒），
1.en: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

1.zh: 到一个童女那里，是已经许配大卫家的一个人，名叫约瑟。童女的名字叫马利亚；
1.en: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

1.zh: 天使进去，对她说：「蒙大恩的女子，我问你安，主和你同在了！」
1.en: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

1.zh: 马利亚因这话就很惊慌，又反复思想这样问安是什么意思。
1.en: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

1.zh: 天使对她说：「马利亚，不要怕！你在　神面前已经蒙恩了。
1.en: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

1.zh: 你要怀孕生子，可以给他起名叫耶稣。
1.en: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

1.zh: 他要为大，称为至高者的儿子；主　神要把他祖大卫的位给他。
1.en: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

1.zh: 他要作雅各家的王，直到永远；他的国也没有穷尽。」
1.en: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

1.zh: 马利亚对天使说：「我没有出嫁，怎么有这事呢？」
1.en: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

1.zh: 天使回答说：「圣灵要临到你身上，至高者的能力要荫庇你，因此所要生的圣者必称为　神的儿子。
1.en: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

1.zh: 况且你的亲戚伊利莎白，在年老的时候也怀了男胎，就是那素来称为不生育的，现在有孕六个月了。
1.en: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

1.zh: 因为，出于　神的话，没有一句不带能力的。」
1.en: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

1.zh: 马利亚说：「我是主的使女，情愿照你的话成就在我身上。」天使就离开她去了。
1.en: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

1.zh: 那时候，马利亚起身，急忙往山地里去，来到犹大的一座城；
1.en: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

1.zh: 进了撒迦利亚的家，问伊利莎白安。
1.en: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

1.zh: 伊利莎白一听马利亚问安，所怀的胎就在腹里跳动。伊利莎白且被圣灵充满，
1.en: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

1.zh: 高声喊着说：「你在妇女中是有福的！你所怀的胎也是有福的！
1.en: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

1.zh: 我主的母到我这里来，这是从哪里得的呢？
1.en: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

1.zh: 因为你问安的声音一入我耳，我腹里的胎就欢喜跳动。
1.en: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

1.zh: 这相信的女子是有福的！因为主对她所说的话都要应验。」
1.en: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

1.zh: 马利亚说： 我心尊主为大；
1.en: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

1.zh: 我灵以　神我的救主为乐；
1.en: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

1.zh: 因为他顾念他使女的卑微； 从今以后， 万代要称我有福。
1.en: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

1.zh: 那有权能的，为我成就了大事； 他的名为圣。
1.en: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

1.zh: 他怜悯敬畏他的人， 直到世世代代。
1.en: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

1.zh: 他用膀臂施展大能； 那狂傲的人正心里妄想就被他赶散了。
1.en: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

1.zh: 他叫有权柄的失位， 叫卑贱的升高；
1.en: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

1.zh: 叫饥饿的得饱美食， 叫富足的空手回去。
1.en: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

1.zh: 他扶助了他的仆人以色列，
1.en: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

1.zh: 为要记念亚伯拉罕和他的后裔， 施怜悯直到永远， 正如从前对我们列祖所说的话。
1.en: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

1.zh: 马利亚和伊利莎白同住，约有三个月，就回家去了。
1.en: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

1.zh: 伊利莎白的产期到了，就生了一个儿子。
1.en: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

1.zh: 邻里亲族听见主向她大施怜悯，就和她一同欢乐。
1.en: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

1.zh: 到了第八日，他们来要给孩子行割礼，并要照他父亲的名字叫他撒迦利亚。
1.en: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

1.zh: 他母亲说：「不可！要叫他约翰。」
1.en: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

1.zh: 他们说：「你亲族中没有叫这名字的。」
1.en: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

1.zh: 他们就向他父亲打手式，问他要叫这孩子什么名字。
1.en: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

1.zh: 他要了一块写字的板，就写上，说：「他的名字是约翰。」他们便都希奇。
1.en: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

1.zh: 撒迦利亚的口立时开了，舌头也[舒展了]，就说出话来，称颂　神。
1.en: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

1.zh: 周围居住的人都惧怕；这一切的事就传遍了犹太的山地。
1.en: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

1.zh: 凡听见的人都将这事放在心里，说：「这个孩子将来怎么样呢？因为有主与他同在。」
1.en: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

1.zh: 他父亲撒迦利亚被圣灵充满了，就预言说：
1.en: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

1.zh: 主—以色列的　神是应当称颂的！ 因他眷顾他的百姓，为他们施行救赎，
1.en: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

1.zh: 在他仆人大卫家中， 为我们兴起了拯救的角，
1.en: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

1.zh: 正如主借着从创世以来圣先知的口所说的话，
1.en: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

1.zh: 拯救我们脱离仇敌 和一切恨我们之人的手，
1.en: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

1.zh: 向我们列祖施怜悯， 记念他的圣约—
1.en: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

1.zh: 就是他对我们祖宗亚伯拉罕所起的誓—
1.en: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

1.zh: 叫我们既从仇敌手中被救出来，
1.en: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

1.zh: 就可以终身在他面前， 坦然无惧地用圣洁、公义事奉他。
1.en: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

1.zh: 孩子啊！你要称为至高者的先知； 因为你要行在主的前面， 预备他的道路，
1.en: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

1.zh: 叫他的百姓因罪得赦， 就知道救恩。
1.en: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

1.zh: 因我们　神怜悯的心肠， 叫清晨的日光从高天临到我们，
1.en: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

1.zh: 要照亮坐在黑暗中死荫里的人， 把我们的脚引到平安的路上。
1.en: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

1.zh: 那孩子渐渐长大，心灵强健，住在旷野，直到他显明在以色列人面前的日子。
1.en: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

2.zh: 当那些日子，凯撒奥古斯都有旨意下来，叫天下人民都报名上册。
2.en: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

2.zh: 这是居里扭作叙利亚巡抚的时候，头一次行报名上册的事。
2.en: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

2.zh: 众人各归各城，报名上册。
2.en: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

2.zh: 约瑟也从加利利的拿撒勒城上犹太去，到了大卫的城，名叫伯利恒，因他本是大卫一族一家的人，
2.en: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

2.zh: 要和他所聘之妻马利亚一同报名上册。那时马利亚的身孕已经重了。
2.en: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

2.zh: 他们在那里的时候，马利亚的产期到了，
2.en: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

2.zh: 就生了头胎的儿子，用布包起来，放在马槽里，因为客店里没有地方。
2.en: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

2.zh: 在伯利恒之野地里有牧羊的人，夜间按着更次看守羊群。
2.en: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

2.zh: 有主的使者站在他们旁边，主的荣光四面照着他们；牧羊的人就甚惧怕。
2.en: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

2.zh: 那天使对他们说：「不要惧怕！我报给你们大喜的信息，是关乎万民的；
2.en: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

2.zh: 因今天在大卫的城里，为你们生了救主，就是主基督。
2.en: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

2.zh: 你们要看见一个婴孩，包着布，卧在[马]槽里，那就是记号了。」
2.en: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

2.zh: 忽然，有一大队天兵同那天使赞美　神说：
2.en: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

2.zh: 在至高之处荣耀归与　神！ 在地上平安归与他所喜悦的人！
2.en: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

2.zh: 众天使离开他们，升天去了。牧羊的人彼此说：「我们往伯利恒去，看看所成的事，就是主所指示我们的。」
2.en: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

2.zh: 他们急忙去了，就寻见马利亚和约瑟，又有那婴孩卧在[马]槽里；
2.en: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

2.zh: 既然看见，就把天使论这孩子的话传开了。
2.en: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

2.zh: 凡听见的，就诧异牧羊之人对他们所说的话。
2.en: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

2.zh: 马利亚却把这一切的事存在心里，反复思想。
2.en: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

2.zh: 牧羊的人回去了，因所听见所看见的一切事，正如[天使]向他们所说的，就归荣耀与　神，赞美他。
2.en: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

2.zh: 满了八天，就给孩子行割礼，与他起名叫耶稣；这就是没有成胎以前，天使所起的名。
2.en: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

2.zh: 按摩西律法满了洁净的日子，他们带着孩子上耶路撒冷去，要把他献与主，（
2.en: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

2.zh: 正如主的律法上所记：「凡头生的男子必称圣归主。」）
2.en: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

2.zh: 又要照主的律法上所说，或用一对斑鸠，或用两只雏鸽献祭。
2.en: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

2.zh: 在耶路撒冷有一个人，名叫西面；这人又公义又虔诚，素常盼望以色列的安慰[者]来到，又有圣灵在他身上。
2.en: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

2.zh: 他得了圣灵的启示，知道自己未死以前，必看见主所立的基督。
2.en: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

2.zh: 他受了[圣]灵的感动，进入圣殿，正遇见耶稣的父母抱着孩子进来，要照律法的规矩办理。
2.en: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

2.zh: 西面就用手接过他来，称颂　神说：
2.en: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

2.zh: 主啊！如今可以照你的话， 释放仆人安然去世；
2.en: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

2.zh: 因为我的眼睛已经看见你的救恩—
2.en: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

2.zh: 就是你在万民面前所预备的：
2.en: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

2.zh: 是照亮外邦人的光， 又是你民以色列的荣耀。
2.en: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

2.zh: 孩子的父母因这论耶稣的话就希奇。
2.en: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

2.zh: 西面给他们祝福，又对孩子的母亲马利亚说：「这[孩子]被立，是要叫以色列中许多人跌倒，许多人兴起；又要作毁谤的话柄，叫许多人心里的意念显露出来；你自己的心也要被刀刺透。」
2.en: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

2.zh: 又有女先知，名叫亚拿，是亚设支派法内力的女儿，年纪已经老迈，从作童女出嫁的时候，同丈夫住了七年就寡居了，
2.en: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

2.zh: 现在已经八十四岁，并不离开圣殿，禁食祈求，昼夜事奉　神。
2.en: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

2.zh: 正当那时，她进前来称谢　神，将孩子的事对一切盼望耶路撒冷得救赎的人讲说。
2.en: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

2.zh: 约瑟和马利亚照主的律法办完了一切的事，就回加利利，到自己的城拿撒勒去了。
2.en: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

2.zh: 孩子渐渐长大，强健起来，充满智慧，又有　神的恩在他身上。
2.en: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

2.zh: 每年到逾越节，他父母就上耶路撒冷去。
2.en: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

2.zh: 当他十二岁的时候，他们按着节期的规矩上去。
2.en: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

2.zh: 守满了节期，他们回去，孩童耶稣仍旧在耶路撒冷。他的父母并不知道，
2.en: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

2.zh: 以为他在同行的人中间，走了一天的路程，就在亲族和熟识的人中找他，
2.en: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

2.zh: 既找不着，就回耶路撒冷去找他。
2.en: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

2.zh: 过了三天，就遇见他在殿里，坐在教师中间，一面听，一面问。
2.en: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

2.zh: 凡听见他的，都希奇他的聪明和他的应对。
2.en: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

2.zh: 他父母看见就很希奇。他母亲对他说：「我儿！为什么向我们这样行呢？看哪，你父亲和我伤心来找你！」
2.en: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

2.zh: 耶稣说：「为什么找我呢？岂不知我应当以我父的事为念吗？」
2.en: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

2.zh: 他所说的这话，他们不明白。
2.en: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

2.zh: 他就同他们下去，回到拿撒勒，并且顺从他们。他母亲把这一切的事都存在心里。
2.en: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

2.zh: 耶稣的智慧和身量，并　神和人喜爱他的心，都一齐增长。
2.en: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

3.zh: 凯撒提庇留在位第十五年，本丢·彼拉多作犹太巡抚，希律作加利利分封的王，他兄弟腓力作以土利亚和特拉可尼地方分封的王，吕撒聂作亚比利尼分封的王，
3.en: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

3.zh: 亚那和该亚法作大祭司。那时，撒迦利亚的儿子约翰在旷野里，　神的话临到他。
3.en: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

3.zh: 他就来到约旦河一带地方，宣讲悔改的洗礼，使罪得赦。
3.en: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

3.zh: 正如先知以赛亚书上所记的话，说： 在旷野有人声喊着说： 预备主的道， 修直他的路！
3.en: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

3.zh: 一切山洼都要填满； 大小山冈都要削平！ 弯弯曲曲的地方要改为正直； 高高低低的道路要改为平坦！
3.en: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

3.zh: 凡有血气的，都要见　神的救恩！
3.en: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

3.zh: 约翰对那出来要受他洗的众人说：「毒蛇的种类！谁指示你们逃避将来的忿怒呢？
3.en: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

3.zh: 你们要结出果子来，与悔改的心相称。不要自己心里说：『有亚伯拉罕为我们的祖宗。』我告诉你们，　神能从这些石头中，给亚伯拉罕兴起子孙来。
3.en: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

3.zh: 现在斧子已经放在树根上，凡不结好果子的树就砍下来，丢在火里。」
3.en: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

3.zh: 众人问他说：「这样，我们当做什么呢？」
3.en: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

3.zh: 约翰回答说：「有两件衣裳的，就分给那没有的；有食物的，也当这样行。」
3.en: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

3.zh: 又有税吏来要受洗，问他说：「夫子，我们当做什么呢？」
3.en: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

3.zh: 约翰说：「除了例定的数目，不要多取。」
3.en: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

3.zh: 又有兵丁问他说：「我们当做什么呢？」约翰说：「不要以强暴待人，也不要讹诈人，自己有钱粮就当知足。」
3.en: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

3.zh: 百姓指望[基督来]的时候，人都心里猜疑，或者约翰是基督。
3.en: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

3.zh: 约翰说：「我是用水给你们施洗，但有一位能力比我更大的要来，我就是给他解鞋带也不配。他要用圣灵与火给你们施洗。
3.en: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

3.zh: 他手里拿着簸箕，要扬净他的场，把麦子收在仓里，把糠用不灭的火烧尽了。」
3.en: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

3.zh: 约翰又用许多别的话劝百姓，向他们传福音。
3.en: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

3.zh: 只是分封的王希律，因他兄弟之妻希罗底的缘故，并因他所行的一切恶事，受了约翰的责备；
3.en: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

3.zh: 又另外添了一件，就是把约翰收在监里。
3.en: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

3.zh: 众百姓都受了洗，耶稣也受了洗。正祷告的时候，天就开了，
3.en: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

3.zh: 圣灵降临在他身上，形状仿佛鸽子；又有声音从天上来，说：「你是我的爱子，我喜悦你。」
3.en: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

3.zh: 耶稣开头[传道]，年纪约有三十岁。依人看来，他是约瑟的儿子；约瑟是希里的儿子；
3.en: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

3.zh: 希里是玛塔的儿子；玛塔是利未的儿子；利未是麦基的儿子；麦基是雅拿的儿子；雅拿是约瑟的儿子；
3.en: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

3.zh: 约瑟是玛他提亚的儿子；玛他提亚是亚摩斯的儿子；亚摩斯是拿鸿的儿子；拿鸿是以斯利的儿子；以斯利是拿该的儿子；
3.en: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

3.zh: 拿该是玛押的儿子；玛押是玛他提亚的儿子；玛他提亚是西美的儿子；西美是约瑟的儿子；约瑟是犹大的儿子；犹大是约亚拿的儿子；
3.en: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

3.zh: 约亚拿是利撒的儿子；利撒是所罗巴伯的儿子；所罗巴伯是撒拉铁的儿子；撒拉铁是尼利的儿子；尼利是麦基的儿子；
3.en: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

3.zh: 麦基是亚底的儿子；亚底是哥桑的儿子；哥桑是以摩当的儿子；以摩当是珥的儿子；珥是约细的儿子；
3.en: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

3.zh: 约细是以利以谢的儿子；以利以谢是约令的儿子；约令是玛塔的儿子；玛塔是利未的儿子；
3.en: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

3.zh: 利未是西缅的儿子；西缅是犹大的儿子；犹大是约瑟的儿子；约瑟是约南的儿子；约南是以利亚敬的儿子；
3.en: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

3.zh: 以利亚敬是米利亚的儿子；米利亚是买南的儿子；买南是玛达他的儿子；玛达他是拿单的儿子；拿单是大卫的儿子；
3.en: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

3.zh: 大卫是耶西的儿子；耶西是俄备得的儿子；俄备得是波阿斯的儿子；波阿斯是撒门的儿子；撒门是拿顺的儿子；
3.en: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

3.zh: 拿顺是亚米拿达的儿子；亚米拿达是亚兰的儿子；亚兰是希斯仑的儿子；希斯仑是法勒斯的儿子；法勒斯是犹大的儿子；
3.en: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

3.zh: 犹大是雅各的儿子；雅各是以撒的儿子；以撒是亚伯拉罕的儿子；亚伯拉罕是他拉的儿子；他拉是拿鹤的儿子；
3.en: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

3.zh: 拿鹤是西鹿的儿子；西鹿是拉吴的儿子；拉吴是法勒的儿子；法勒是希伯的儿子；希伯是沙拉的儿子；
3.en: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

3.zh: 沙拉是该南的儿子；该南是亚法撒的儿子；亚法撒是闪的儿子；闪是挪亚的儿子；挪亚是拉麦的儿子；
3.en: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

3.zh: 拉麦是玛土撒拉的儿子；玛土撒拉是以诺的儿子；以诺是雅列的儿子；雅列是玛勒列的儿子；玛勒列是该南的儿子；该南是以挪士的儿子；
3.en: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

3.zh: 以挪士是塞特的儿子；塞特是亚当的儿子；亚当是　神的儿子。
3.en: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

4.zh: 耶稣被圣灵充满，从约旦河回来，圣灵将他引到旷野，
4.en: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

4.zh: 四十天受魔鬼的试探。那些日子没有吃什么；日子满了，他就饿了。
4.en: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

4.zh: 魔鬼对他说：「你若是　神的儿子，可以吩咐这块石头变成食物。」
4.en: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

4.zh: 耶稣回答说：「[经上]记着说：『人活着不是单靠食物，[乃是靠　神口里所出的一切话]。』」
4.en: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

4.zh: 魔鬼又领他上了[高山]，霎时间把天下的万国都指给他看，
4.en: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

4.zh: 对他说：「这一切权柄、荣华，我都要给你，因为这原是交付我的，我愿意给谁就给谁。
4.en: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

4.zh: 你若在我面前下拜，这都要归你。」
4.en: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

4.zh: 耶稣说：「[经上]记着说： 当拜主—你的　神， 单要事奉他。」
4.en: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

4.zh: 魔鬼又领他到耶路撒冷去，叫他站在殿顶上，对他说：「你若是　神的儿子，可以从这里跳下去；
4.en: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

4.zh: 因为[经上]记着说： 主要为你吩咐他的使者保护你；
4.en: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

4.zh: 他们要用手托着你， 免得你的脚碰在石头上。」
4.en: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

4.zh: 耶稣对他说：「[经上]说：『不可试探主—你的　神。』」
4.en: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

4.zh: 魔鬼用完了各样的试探，就暂时离开耶稣。
4.en: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

4.zh: 耶稣满有圣灵的能力，回到加利利；他的名声就传遍了四方。
4.en: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

4.zh: 他在各会堂里教训人，众人都称赞他。
4.en: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

4.zh: 耶稣来到拿撒勒，就是他长大的地方。在安息日，照他平常的规矩进了会堂，站起来要念[圣经]。
4.en: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

4.zh: 有人把先知以赛亚的书交给他，他就打开，找到一处写着说：
4.en: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

4.zh: 主的灵在我身上， 因为他用膏膏我， 叫我传福音给贫穷的人； 差遣我报告： 被掳的得释放， 瞎眼的得看见， 叫那受压制的得自由，
4.en: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

4.zh: 报告　神悦纳人的禧年。
4.en: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

4.zh: 于是把书卷起来，交还执事，就坐下。会堂里的人都定睛看他。
4.en: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

4.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「今天这经应验在你们耳中了。」
4.en: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

4.zh: 众人都称赞他，并希奇他口中所出的恩言；又说：「这不是约瑟的儿子吗？」
4.en: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

4.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们必引这俗语向我说：『医生，你医治自己吧！我们听见你在迦百农所行的事，也当行在你自己家乡里』」；
4.en: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

4.zh: 又说：「我实在告诉你们，没有先知在自己家乡被人悦纳的。
4.en: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

4.zh: 我对你们说实话，当以利亚的时候，天闭塞了三年零六个月，遍地有大饥荒，那时，以色列中有许多寡妇，
4.en: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

4.zh: 以利亚并没有奉差往她们一个人那里去，只奉差往西顿的撒勒法一个寡妇那里去。
4.en: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

4.zh: 先知以利沙的时候，以色列中有许多长大麻风的，但内中除了叙利亚国的乃缦，没有一个得洁净的。」
4.en: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

4.zh: 会堂里的人听见这话，都怒气满胸，
4.en: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

4.zh: 就起来撵他出城（他们的城造在山上）；他们带他到山崖，要把他推下去。
4.en: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

4.zh: 他却从他们中间直行，过去了。
4.en: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

4.zh: 耶稣下到迦百农，就是加利利的一座城，在安息日教训众人。
4.en: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

4.zh: 他们很希奇他的教训，因为他的话里有权柄。
4.en: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

4.zh: 在会堂里有一个人，被污鬼的精气附着，大声喊叫说：
4.en: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

4.zh: 「唉！拿撒勒的耶稣，我们与你有什么相干？你来灭我们吗？我知道你是谁，乃是　神的圣者。」
4.en: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

4.zh: 耶稣责备他说：「不要作声，从这人身上出来吧！」鬼把那人摔倒在众人中间，就出来了，却也没有害他。
4.en: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

4.zh: 众人都惊讶，彼此对问说：「这是什么道理呢？因为他用权柄能力吩咐污鬼，污鬼就出来。」
4.en: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

4.zh: 于是耶稣的名声传遍了周围地方。
4.en: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

4.zh: 耶稣出了会堂，进了西门的家。西门的岳母害热病甚重，有人为她求耶稣。
4.en: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

4.zh: 耶稣站在她旁边，斥责那热病，热就退了。她立刻起来服事他们。
4.en: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

4.zh: 日落的时候，凡有病人的，不论害什么病，都带到耶稣那里。耶稣按手在他们各人身上，医好他们。
4.en: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

4.zh: 又有鬼从好些人身上出来，喊着说：「你是　神的儿子。」耶稣斥责他们，不许他们说话，因为他们知道他是基督。
4.en: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

4.zh: 天亮的时候，耶稣出来，走到旷野地方。众人去找他，到了他那里，要留住他，不要他离开他们。
4.en: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

4.zh: 但耶稣对他们说：「我也必须在别城传　神国的福音，因我奉差原是为此。」
4.en: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

4.zh: 于是耶稣在加利利的各会堂传道。
4.en: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

5.zh: 耶稣站在革尼撒勒湖边，众人拥挤他，要听　神的道。
5.en: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

5.zh: 他见有两只船湾在湖边；打鱼的人却离开船洗网去了。
5.en: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

5.zh: 有一只船是西门的，耶稣就上去，请他把船撑开，稍微离岸，就坐下，从船上教训众人。
5.en: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

5.zh: 讲完了，对西门说：「把船开到水深之处，下网打鱼。」
5.en: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

5.zh: 西门说：「夫子，我们整夜劳力，并没有打着什么。但依从你的话，我就下网。」
5.en: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

5.zh: 他们下了网，就圈住许多鱼，网险些裂开，
5.en: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

5.zh: 便招呼那只船上的同伴来帮助。他们就来，把鱼装满了两只船，甚至船要沉下去。
5.en: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

5.zh: 西门·彼得看见，就俯伏在耶稣膝前，说：「主啊，离开我，我是个罪人！」
5.en: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

5.zh: 他和一切同在的人都惊讶这一网所打的鱼。
5.en: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

5.zh: 他的伙伴西庇太的儿子雅各、约翰，也是这样。耶稣对西门说：「不要怕！从今以后，你要得人了。」
5.en: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

5.zh: 他们把两只船拢了岸，就撇下所有的，跟从了耶稣。
5.en: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

5.zh: 有一回，耶稣在一个城里，有人满身长了大麻风，看见他，就俯伏在地，求他说：「主若肯，必能叫我洁净了。」
5.en: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

5.zh: 耶稣伸手摸他，说：「我肯，你洁净了吧！」大麻风立刻就离了他的身。
5.en: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

5.zh: 耶稣嘱咐他：「你切不可告诉人，只要去把身体给祭司察看，又要为你得了洁净，照摩西所吩咐的献上[礼物]，对众人作证据。」
5.en: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

5.zh: 但耶稣的名声越发传扬出去。有极多的人聚集来听道，也指望医治他们的病。
5.en: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

5.zh: 耶稣却退到旷野去祷告。
5.en: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

5.zh: 有一天，耶稣教训人，有法利赛人和教法师在旁边坐着；他们是从加利利各乡村和犹太并耶路撒冷来的。主的能力与耶稣同在，使他能医治病人。
5.en: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

5.zh: 有人用褥子抬着一个瘫子，要抬进去放在耶稣面前，
5.en: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

5.zh: 却因人多，寻不出法子抬进去，就上了房顶，从瓦间把他连褥子缒到当中，正在耶稣面前。
5.en: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

5.zh: 耶稣见他们的信心，就对瘫子说：「你的罪赦了。」
5.en: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

5.zh: 文士和法利赛人就议论说：「这说僭妄话的是谁？除了　神以外，谁能赦罪呢？」
5.en: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

5.zh: 耶稣知道他们所议论的，就说：「你们心里议论的是什么呢？
5.en: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

5.zh: 或说『你的罪赦了』，或说『你起来行走』，哪一样容易呢？
5.en: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

5.zh: 但要叫你们知道，人子在地上有赦罪的权柄。」就对瘫子说：「我吩咐你，起来，拿你的褥子回家去吧！」
5.en: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

5.zh: 那人当众人面前立刻起来，拿着他所躺卧的[褥子]回家去，归荣耀与　神。
5.en: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

5.zh: 众人都惊奇，也归荣耀与　神，并且满心惧怕，说：「我们今日看见非常的事了。」
5.en: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

5.zh: 这事以后，耶稣出去，看见一个税吏，名叫利未，坐在税关上，就对他说：「你跟从我来。」
5.en: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

5.zh: 他就撇下所有的，起来，跟从了耶稣。
5.en: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

5.zh: 利未在自己家里为耶稣大摆筵席，有许多税吏和别人与他们一同坐席。
5.en: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

5.zh: 法利赛人和文士就向耶稣的门徒发怨言说：「你们为什么和税吏并罪人一同吃喝呢？」
5.en: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

5.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「无病的人用不着医生；有病的人才用得着。
5.en: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

5.zh: 我来本不是召义人悔改，乃是召罪人悔改。」
5.en: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

5.zh: 他们说：「约翰的门徒屡次禁食祈祷，法利赛人的[门徒]也是这样；惟独你的门徒又吃又喝。」
5.en: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

5.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的时候，岂能叫陪伴之人禁食呢？
5.en: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

5.zh: 但日子将到，新郎要离开他们，那日他们就要禁食了。」
5.en: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

5.zh: 耶稣又设一个比喻，对他们说：「没有人把新衣服撕下一块来补在旧衣服上；若是这样，就把新的撕破了，并且所撕下来的那块新的和旧的也不相称。
5.en: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

5.zh: 也没有人把新酒装在旧皮袋里；若是这样，新酒必将皮袋裂开，酒便漏出来，皮袋也就坏了。
5.en: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

5.zh: 但新酒必须装在新皮袋里。
5.en: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

5.zh: 没有人喝了陈酒又想喝新的；他总说陈的好。」
5.en: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

6.zh: 有一个安息日，耶稣从麦地经过。他的门徒掐了麦穗，用手搓着吃。
6.en: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

6.zh: 有几个法利赛人说：「你们为什么做安息日不可做的事呢？」
6.en: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

6.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「[经上记着]大卫和跟从他的人饥饿之时所做的事，连这个你们也没有念过吗？
6.en: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

6.zh: 他怎么进了　神的殿，拿陈设饼吃，又给跟从的人吃？这饼除了祭司以外，别人都不可吃。」
6.en: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

6.zh: 又对他们说：「人子是安息日的主。」
6.en: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

6.zh: 又有一个安息日，耶稣进了会堂教训人，在那里有一个人右手枯干了。
6.en: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

6.zh: 文士和法利赛人窥探耶稣，在安息日治病不治病，要得把柄去告他。
6.en: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

6.zh: 耶稣却知道他们的意念，就对那枯干一只手的人说：「起来！站在当中。」那人就起来，站着。
6.en: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

6.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我问你们，在安息日行善行恶，救命害命，哪样是可以的呢？」
6.en: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

6.zh: 他就周围看着他们众人，对那人说：「伸出手来！」他把手一伸，手就复了原。
6.en: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

6.zh: 他们就满心大怒，彼此商议怎样处治耶稣。
6.en: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

6.zh: 那时，耶稣出去，上山祷告，整夜祷告　神；
6.en: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

6.zh: 到了天亮，叫他的门徒来，就从他们中间挑选十二个人，称他们为使徒。
6.en: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

6.zh: [这十二个人]有西门（耶稣又给他起名叫彼得），还有他兄弟安得烈，又有雅各和约翰，腓力和巴多罗买，
6.en: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

6.zh: 马太和多马，亚勒腓的儿子雅各和奋锐党的西门，
6.en: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

6.zh: 雅各的儿子犹大，和卖主的加略人犹大。
6.en: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

6.zh: 耶稣和他们下了山，站在一块平地上；同站的有许多门徒，又有许多百姓，从犹太全地和耶路撒冷，并泰尔、西顿的海边来，都要听他[讲道]，又指望医治他们的病；
6.en: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

6.zh: 还有被污鬼缠磨的，也得了医治。
6.en: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

6.zh: 众人都想要摸他；因为有能力从他身上发出来，医好了他们。
6.en: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

6.zh: 耶稣举目看着门徒，说： 你们贫穷的人有福了！ 因为　神的国是你们的。
6.en: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

6.zh: 你们饥饿的人有福了！ 因为你们将要饱足。 你们哀哭的人有福了！ 因为你们将要喜笑。
6.en: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

6.zh: 「人为人子恨恶你们，拒绝你们，辱骂你们，弃掉你们的名，以为是恶，你们就有福了！
6.en: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

6.zh: 当那日，你们要[欢喜]跳跃，因为你们在天上的赏赐是大的。他们的祖宗待先知也是这样。
6.en: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

6.zh: 但你们富足的人有祸了！ 因为你们受过你们的安慰。
6.en: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

6.zh: 你们饱足的人有祸了！ 因为你们将要饥饿。 你们喜笑的人有祸了！ 因为你们将要哀恸哭泣。
6.en: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

6.zh: 「人都说你们好的时候，你们就有祸了！因为他们的祖宗待假先知也是这样。」
6.en: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

6.zh: 「只是我告诉你们这听道的人，你们的仇敌，要爱他！恨你们的，要待他好！
6.en: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

6.zh: 咒诅你们的，要为他祝福！凌辱你们的，要为他祷告！
6.en: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

6.zh: 有人打你这边的脸，连那边的脸也由他打。有人夺你的外衣，连里衣也由他拿去。
6.en: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

6.zh: 凡求你的，就给他。有人夺你的东西去，不用再要回来。
6.en: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

6.zh: 你们愿意人怎样待你们，你们也要怎样待人。
6.en: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

6.zh: 你们若单爱那爱你们的人，有什么可酬谢的呢？就是罪人也爱那爱他们的人。
6.en: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

6.zh: 你们若善待那善待你们的人，有什么可酬谢的呢？就是罪人也是这样行。
6.en: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

6.zh: 你们若借给人，指望从他收回，有什么可酬谢的呢？就是罪人也借给罪人，要如数收回。
6.en: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

6.zh: 你们倒要爱仇敌，也要善待他们，并要借给人不指望偿还，你们的赏赐就必大了，你们也必作至高者的儿子，因为他恩待那忘恩的和作恶的。
6.en: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

6.zh: 你们要慈悲，像你们的父慈悲一样。」
6.en: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

6.zh: 「你们不要论断人，就不被论断；你们不要定人的罪，就不被定罪；你们要饶恕人，就必蒙饶恕；
6.en: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

6.zh: 你们要给人，就必有给你们的，并且用十足的升斗，连摇带按，上尖下流地倒在你们怀里；因为你们用什么量器量给人，也必用什么量器量给你们。」
6.en: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

6.zh: 耶稣又用比喻对他们说：「瞎子岂能领瞎子，两个人不是都要掉在坑里吗？
6.en: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

6.zh: 学生不能高过先生；凡学成了的不过和先生一样。
6.en: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

6.zh: 为什么看见你弟兄眼中有刺，却不想自己眼中有梁木呢？
6.en: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

6.zh: 你不见自己眼中有梁木，怎能对你弟兄说：『容我去掉你眼中的刺』呢？你这假冒为善的人！先去掉自己眼中的梁木，然后才能看得清楚，去掉你弟兄眼中的刺。」
6.en: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

6.zh: 「因为，没有好树结坏果子，也没有坏树结好果子。
6.en: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

6.zh: 凡树木看果子，就可以认出它来。人不是从荆棘上摘无花果，也不是从蒺藜里摘葡萄。
6.en: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

6.zh: 善人从他心里所存的善就发出善来；恶人从他[心里]所存的恶就发出恶来；因为心里所充满的，口里就说出来。」
6.en: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

6.zh: 「你们为什么称呼我『主啊，主啊』却不遵我的话行呢？
6.en: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

6.zh: 凡到我这里来，听见我的话就去行的，我要告诉你们他像什么人：
6.en: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

6.zh: 他像一个人盖房子，深深地挖地，把根基安在磐石上；到发大水的时候，水冲那房子，房子总不能摇动，因为根基立在磐石上。
6.en: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

6.zh: 惟有听见不去行的，就像一个人在土地上盖房子，没有根基；水一冲，随即倒塌了，并且那房子坏的很大。」
6.en: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

7.zh: 耶稣对百姓讲完了这一切的话，就进了迦百农。
7.en: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

7.zh: 有一个百夫长所宝贵的仆人害病，快要死了。
7.en: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

7.zh: 百夫长风闻耶稣的事，就托犹太人的几个长老去求耶稣来救他的仆人。
7.en: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

7.zh: 他们到了耶稣那里，就切切地求他说：「你给他行这事是他所配得的；
7.en: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

7.zh: 因为他爱我们的百姓，给我们建造会堂。」
7.en: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

7.zh: 耶稣就和他们同去。离那家不远，百夫长托几个朋友去见耶稣，对他说：「主啊！不要劳动；因你到我舍下，我不敢当。
7.en: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

7.zh: 我也自以为不配去见你，只要你说一句话，我的仆人就必好了。
7.en: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

7.zh: 因为我在人的权下，也有兵在我以下，对这个说：『去！』他就去；对那个说：『来！』他就来；对我的仆人说：『你做这事！』他就去做。」
7.en: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

7.zh: 耶稣听见这话，就希奇他，转身对跟随的众人说：「我告诉你们，这么大的信心，就是在以色列中，我也没有遇见过。」
7.en: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

7.zh: 那托来的人回到百夫长家里，看见仆人已经好了。
7.en: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

7.zh: 过了不多时，耶稣往一座城去，这城名叫拿因，他的门徒和极多的人与他同行。
7.en: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

7.zh: 将近城门，有一个死人被抬出来。这人是他母亲独生的儿子；他母亲又是寡妇。有城里的许多人同着寡妇送殡。
7.en: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

7.zh: 主看见那寡妇，就怜悯她，对她说：「不要哭！」
7.en: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

7.zh: 于是进前按着杠，抬的人就站住了。耶稣说：「少年人，我吩咐你，起来！」
7.en: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

7.zh: 那死人就坐起，并且说话。耶稣便把他交给他母亲。
7.en: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

7.zh: 众人都惊奇，归荣耀与　神，说：「有大先知在我们中间兴起来了！」又说：「　神眷顾了他的百姓！」
7.en: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

7.zh: 他这事的风声就传遍了犹太和周围地方。
7.en: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

7.zh: 约翰的门徒把这些事都告诉约翰。
7.en: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

7.zh: 他便叫了两个门徒来，打发他们到主那里去，说：「那将要来的是你吗？还是我们等候别人呢？」
7.en: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

7.zh: 那两个人来到耶稣那里，说：「施洗的约翰打发我们来问你：『那将要来的是你吗？还是我们等候别人呢？』」
7.en: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

7.zh: 正当那时候，耶稣治好了许多有疾病的，受灾患的，被恶鬼附着的，又开恩叫好些瞎子能看见。
7.en: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

7.zh: 耶稣回答说：「你们去，把所看见所听见的事告诉约翰，就是瞎子看见，瘸子行走，长大麻风的洁净，聋子听见，死人复活，穷人有福音传给他们。
7.en: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

7.zh: 凡不因我跌倒的，就有福了！」
7.en: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

7.zh: 约翰所差来的人既走了，耶稣就对众人讲论约翰说：「你们从前出去到旷野，是要看什么呢？要看风吹动的芦苇吗？
7.en: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

7.zh: 你们出去，到底是要看什么？要看穿细软衣服的人吗？那穿华丽衣服、宴乐度日的人是在王宫里。
7.en: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

7.zh: 你们出去，究竟是要看什么？要看先知吗？我告诉你们，是的，他比先知大多了。
7.en: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

7.zh: [经上]记着说：『我要差遣我的使者在你前面预备道路』，所说的就是这个人。
7.en: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

7.zh: 我告诉你们，凡妇人所生的，没有一个大过约翰的；然而　神国里最小的比他还大。」
7.en: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

7.zh: 众百姓和税吏既受过约翰的洗，听见这话，就以　神为义；
7.en: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

7.zh: 但法利赛人和律法师没有受过约翰的洗，竟为自己废弃了　神 的旨意。
7.en: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

7.zh: [主又说]：「这样，我可用什么比这世代的人呢？他们好像什么呢？
7.en: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

7.zh: 好像孩童坐在街市上，彼此呼叫说： 我们向你们吹笛， 你们不跳舞； 我们向你们举哀， 你们不啼哭。
7.en: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

7.zh: 施洗的约翰来，不吃饼，不喝酒，你们说他是被鬼附着的。
7.en: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

7.zh: 人子来，也吃也喝，你们说他是贪食好酒的人，是税吏和罪人的朋友。
7.en: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

7.zh: 但智慧之子都以智慧为是。」
7.en: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

7.zh: 有一个法利赛人请耶稣和他吃饭；耶稣就到法利赛人家里去坐席。
7.en: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

7.zh: 那城里有一个女人，是个罪人，知道耶稣在法利赛人家里坐席，就拿着盛香膏的玉瓶，
7.en: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

7.zh: 站在耶稣背后，挨着他的脚哭，眼泪湿了耶稣的脚，就用自己的头发擦干，又用嘴连连亲他的脚，把香膏抹上。
7.en: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

7.zh: 请耶稣的法利赛人看见这事，心里说：「这人若是先知，必知道摸他的是谁，是个怎样的女人；乃是个罪人。」
7.en: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

7.zh: 耶稣对他说：「西门！我有句话要对你说。」西门说：「夫子，请说。」
7.en: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

7.zh: [耶稣说]：「一个债主有两个人欠他的债；一个欠五十两银子，一个欠五两银子；
7.en: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

7.zh: 因为他们无力偿还，债主就开恩免了他们两个人的债。这两个人哪一个更爱他呢？」
7.en: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

7.zh: 西门回答说：「我想是那多得恩免的人。」耶稣说：「你断的不错。」
7.en: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

7.zh: 于是转过来向着那女人，便对西门说：「你看见这女人吗？我进了你的家，你没有给我水洗脚；但这女人用眼泪湿了我的脚，用头发擦干。
7.en: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

7.zh: 你没有与我亲嘴；但这女人从我进来的时候就不住地用嘴亲我的脚。
7.en: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

7.zh: 你没有用油抹我的头；但这女人用香膏抹我的脚。
7.en: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

7.zh: 所以我告诉你，她许多的罪都赦免了，因为她的爱多；但那赦免少的，他的爱就少。」
7.en: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

7.zh: 于是对那女人说：「你的罪赦免了。」
7.en: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

7.zh: 同席的人心里说：「这是什么人，竟赦免人的罪呢？」
7.en: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

7.zh: 耶稣对那女人说：「你的信救了你；平平安安回去吧！」
7.en: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

8.zh: 过了不多日，耶稣周游各城各乡传道，宣讲　神国的福音。和他同去的有十二个门徒，
8.en: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

8.zh: 还有被恶鬼所附、被疾病所累、已经治好的几个妇女，内中有称为抹大拉的马利亚（曾有七个鬼从她身上赶出来），
8.en: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

8.zh: 又有希律的家宰苦撒的妻子约亚拿，并苏撒拿，和好些别的妇女，都是用自己的财物供给耶稣和门徒。
8.en: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

8.zh: 当许多人聚集、又有人从各城里出来见耶稣的时候，耶稣就用比喻说：
8.en: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

8.zh: 「有一个撒种的出去撒种。撒的时候，有落在路旁的，被人践踏，天上的飞鸟又来吃尽了。
8.en: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

8.zh: 有落在磐石上的，一出来就枯干了，因为得不着滋润。
8.en: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

8.zh: 有落在荆棘里的，荆棘一同生长，把它挤住了。
8.en: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

8.zh: 又有落在好土里的，生长起来，结实百倍。」耶稣说了这些话，就大声说：「有耳可听的，就应当听！」
8.en: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

8.zh: 门徒问耶稣说：「这比喻是什么意思呢？」
8.en: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

8.zh: 他说：「　神国的奥秘只叫你们知道；至于别人，就用比喻，叫他们看也看不见，听也听不明。」
8.en: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

8.zh: 「这比喻乃是这样：种子就是　神的道。
8.en: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

8.zh: 那些在路旁的，就是人听了道，随后魔鬼来，从他们心里把道夺去，恐怕他们信了得救。
8.en: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

8.zh: 那些在磐石上的，就是人听道，欢喜领受，但心中没有根，不过暂时相信，及至遇见试炼就退后了。
8.en: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

8.zh: 那落在荆棘里的，就是人听了道，走开以后，被今生的思虑、钱财、宴乐挤住了，便结不出成熟的子粒来。
8.en: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

8.zh: [那落]在好土里的，就是人听了道，持守在诚实善良的心里，并且忍耐着结实。」
8.en: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

8.zh: 「没有人点灯用器皿盖上，或放在床底下，乃是放在灯台上，叫进来的人看见亮光。
8.en: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

8.zh: 因为掩藏的事没有不显出来的；隐瞒的事没有不露出来被人知道的。
8.en: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

8.zh: 所以，你们应当小心怎样听；因为凡有的，还要加给他；凡没有的，连他自以为有的，也要夺去。」
8.en: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

8.zh: 耶稣的母亲和他弟兄来了，因为人多，不得到他跟前。
8.en: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

8.zh: 有人告诉他说：「你母亲和你弟兄站在外边，要见你。」
8.en: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

8.zh: 耶稣回答说：「听了　神之道而遵行的人就是我的母亲，我的弟兄了。」
8.en: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

8.zh: 有一天，耶稣和门徒上了船，对门徒说：「我们可以渡到湖那边去。」他们就开了船。
8.en: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

8.zh: 正行的时候，耶稣睡着了。湖上忽然起了暴风，船将满了[水]，甚是危险。
8.en: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

8.zh: 门徒来叫醒了他，说：「夫子！夫子！我们丧命啦！」耶稣醒了，斥责那狂风大浪；风浪就止住，平静了。
8.en: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

8.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们的信心在哪里呢？」他们又惧怕又希奇，彼此说：「这到底是谁？他吩咐风和水，连风和水也听从他了。」
8.en: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

8.zh: 他们到了格拉森人的地方，就是加利利的对面。
8.en: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

8.zh: 耶稣上了岸，就有城里一个被鬼附着的人迎面而来。这个人许久不穿衣服，不住房子，只住在坟茔里。
8.en: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

8.zh: 他见了耶稣，就俯伏在他面前，大声喊叫，说：「至高　神的儿子耶稣，我与你有什么相干？求你不要叫我受苦！」
8.en: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

8.zh: 是因耶稣曾吩咐污鬼从那人身上出来。原来这鬼屡次抓住他；他常被人看守，又被铁链和脚镣捆锁，他竟把锁链挣断，被鬼赶到旷野去。
8.en: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

8.zh: 耶稣问他说：「你名叫什么？」他说：「我名叫『群』」；这是因为附着他的鬼多。
8.en: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

8.zh: 鬼就央求耶稣，不要吩咐他们到无底坑里去。
8.en: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

8.zh: 那里有一大群猪在山上吃食。鬼央求耶稣，准他们进入猪里去。耶稣准了他们，
8.en: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

8.zh: 鬼就从那人出来，进入猪里去。于是那群猪闯下山崖，投在湖里淹死了。
8.en: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

8.zh: 放猪的看见这事就逃跑了，去告诉城里和乡下的人。
8.en: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

8.zh: 众人出来要看是什么事；到了耶稣那里，看见鬼所离开的那人，坐在耶稣脚前，穿着衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。
8.en: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

8.zh: 看见这事的便将被鬼附着的人怎么得救告诉他们。
8.en: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

8.zh: 格拉森四围的人，因为害怕得很，都求耶稣离开他们；耶稣就上船回去了。
8.en: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

8.zh: 鬼所离开的那人恳求和耶稣同在；耶稣却打发他回去，说：
8.en: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

8.zh: 「你回家去，传说　神为你做了何等大的事。」他就去，满城里传扬耶稣为他做了何等大的事。
8.en: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

8.zh: 耶稣回来的时候，众人迎接他，因为他们都等候他。
8.en: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

8.zh: 有一个管会堂的，名叫睚鲁，来俯伏在耶稣脚前，求耶稣到他家里去；
8.en: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

8.zh: 因他有一个独生女儿，约有十二岁，快要死了。 耶稣去的时候，众人拥挤他。
8.en: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

8.zh: 有一个女人，患了十二年的血漏，在医生手里花尽了她一切养生的，并没有一人能医好她。
8.en: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

8.zh: 她来到耶稣背后，摸他的衣裳 子，血漏立刻就止住了。
8.en: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

8.zh: 耶稣说：「摸我的是谁？」众人都不承认。彼得和同行的人都说：「夫子，众人拥拥挤挤紧靠着你。」
8.en: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

8.zh: 耶稣说：「总有人摸我，因我觉得有能力从我身上出去。」
8.en: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

8.zh: 那女人知道不能隐藏，就战战兢兢地来俯伏在耶稣脚前，把摸他的缘故和怎样立刻得好了，当着众人都说出来。
8.en: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

8.zh: 耶稣对她说：「女儿，你的信救了你；平平安安地去吧！」
8.en: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

8.zh: 还说话的时候，有人从管会堂的家里来，说：「你的女儿死了，不要劳动夫子。」
8.en: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

8.zh: 耶稣听见就对他说：「不要怕，只要信！你的女儿就必得救。」
8.en: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

8.zh: 耶稣到了他的家，除了彼得、约翰、雅各，和女儿的父母，不许别人同他进去。
8.en: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

8.zh: 众人都为这女儿哀哭捶胸。耶稣说：「不要哭！她不是死了，是睡着了。」
8.en: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

8.zh: 他们晓得女儿已经死了，就嗤笑耶稣。
8.en: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

8.zh: 耶稣拉着她的手，呼叫说：「女儿，起来吧！」
8.en: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

8.zh: 她的灵魂便回来，她就立刻起来了。耶稣吩咐给她东西吃。
8.en: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

8.zh: 她的父母惊奇得很；耶稣嘱咐他们，不要把所做的事告诉人。
8.en: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

9.zh: 耶稣叫齐了十二个门徒，给他们能力、权柄，制伏一切的鬼，医治各样的病，
9.en: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

9.zh: 又差遣他们去宣传　神国[的道]，医治病人，
9.en: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

9.zh: 对他们说：「行路的时候，不要带拐杖和口袋，不要带食物和银子，也不要带两件褂子。
9.en: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

9.zh: 无论进哪一家，就住在那里，也从那里起行。
9.en: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

9.zh: 凡不接待你们的，你们离开那城的时候，要把脚上的尘土跺下去，见证他们的不是。」
9.en: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

9.zh: 门徒就出去，走遍各乡宣传福音，到处治病。
9.en: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

9.zh: 分封的王希律听见耶稣所做的一切事，就游移不定；因为有人说：「是约翰从死里复活」；
9.en: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

9.zh: 又有人说：「是以利亚显现」；还有人说：「是古时的一个先知又活了。」
9.en: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

9.zh: 希律说：「约翰我已经斩了，这却是什么人？我竟听见他这样的事呢？」就想要见他。
9.en: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

9.zh: 使徒回来，将所做的事告诉耶稣，耶稣就带他们暗暗地离开那里，往一座城去；那城名叫伯赛大。
9.en: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

9.zh: 但众人知道了，就跟着他去；耶稣便接待他们，对他们讲论　神国[的道]，医治那些需医的人。
9.en: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

9.zh: 日头快要平西，十二个门徒来对他说：「请叫众人散开，他们好往四面乡村里去借宿找吃的，因为我们这里是野地。」
9.en: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「你们给他们吃吧！」门徒说：「我们不过有五个饼，两条鱼，若不去为这许多人买食物就不够。」
9.en: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

9.zh: 那时，人数约有五千。耶稣对门徒说：「叫他们一排一排地坐下，每排大约五十个人。」
9.en: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

9.zh: 门徒就如此行，叫众人都坐下。
9.en: They did so, and made them all sit down.

9.zh: 耶稣拿着这五个饼，两条鱼，望着天祝福，擘开，递给门徒，摆在众人面前。
9.en: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

9.zh: 他们就吃，并且都吃饱了；把剩下的零碎收拾起来，装满了十二篮子。
9.en: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

9.zh: 耶稣自己祷告的时候，门徒也同他在那里。耶稣问他们说：「众人说我是谁？」
9.en: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

9.zh: 他们说：「有人说是施洗的约翰；有人说是以利亚；还有人说是古时的一个先知又活了。」
9.en: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「你们说我是谁？」彼得回答说：「是　神所立的基督。」
9.en: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

9.zh: 耶稣切切地嘱咐他们，不可将这事告诉人，
9.en: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

9.zh: 又说：「人子必须受许多的苦，被长老、祭司长，和文士弃绝，并且被杀，第三日复活。」
9.en: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

9.zh: 耶稣又对众人说：「若有人要跟从我，就当舍己，天天背起他的十字架来跟从我。
9.en: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

9.zh: 因为，凡要救自己生命的，必丧掉生命；凡为我丧掉生命的，必救了生命。
9.en: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

9.zh: 人若赚得全世界，却丧了自己，赔上自己，有什么益处呢？
9.en: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

9.zh: 凡把我和我的道当作可耻的，人子在自己的荣耀里，并天父与圣天使的荣耀里降临的时候，也要把那人当作可耻的。
9.en: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

9.zh: 我实在告诉你们，站在这里的，有人在没尝死味以前，必看见　神的国。」
9.en: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

9.zh: 说了这话以后约有八天，耶稣带着彼得、约翰、雅各上山去祷告。
9.en: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

9.zh: 正祷告的时候，他的面貌就改变了，衣服洁白放光。
9.en: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

9.zh: 忽然有摩西、以利亚两个人同耶稣说话；
9.en: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

9.zh: 他们在荣光里显现，谈论耶稣去世的事，就是他在耶路撒冷将要成的事。
9.en: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

9.zh: 彼得和他的同伴都打盹，既清醒了，就看见耶稣的荣光，并同他站着的那两个人。
9.en: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

9.zh: 二人正要和耶稣分离的时候，彼得对耶稣说：「夫子，我们在这里真好！可以搭三座棚，一座为你，一座为摩西，一座为以利亚。」他却不知道所说的是什么。
9.en: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

9.zh: 说这话的时候，有一朵云彩来遮盖他们；他们进入云彩里就惧怕。
9.en: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

9.zh: 有声音从云彩里出来，说：「这是我的儿子，我所拣选的，你们要听他。」
9.en: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

9.zh: 声音住了，只见耶稣一人在那里。当那些日子，门徒不提所看见的事，一样也不告诉人。
9.en: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

9.zh: 第二天，他们下了山，就有许多人迎见耶稣。
9.en: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

9.zh: 其中有一人喊叫说：「夫子！求你看顾我的儿子，因为他是我的独生子。
9.en: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

9.zh: 他被鬼抓住就忽然喊叫；鬼又叫他抽风，口中流沫，并且重重地伤害他，难以离开他。
9.en: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

9.zh: 我求过你的门徒，把鬼赶出去，他们却是不能。」
9.en: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「嗳！这又不信又悖谬的世代啊，我在你们这里，忍耐你们要到几时呢？将你的儿子带到这里来吧！」
9.en: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

9.zh: 正来的时候，鬼把他摔倒，叫他重重地抽风。耶稣就斥责那污鬼，把孩子治好了，交给他父亲。
9.en: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

9.zh: 众人都诧异　神的大能。 耶稣所做的一切事，众人正希奇的时候，耶稣对门徒说：
9.en: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

9.zh: 「你们要把这些话存在耳中，因为人子将要被交在人手里。」
9.en: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

9.zh: 他们不明白这话，意思乃是隐藏的，叫他们不能明白，他们也不敢问这话的意思。
9.en: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

9.zh: 门徒中间起了议论，谁将为大。
9.en: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

9.zh: 耶稣看出他们心中的议论，就领一个小孩子来，叫他站在自己旁边，
9.en: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

9.zh: 对他们说：「凡为我名接待这小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，就是接待那差我来的。你们中间最小的，他便为大。」
9.en: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

9.zh: 约翰说：「夫子，我们看见一个人奉你的名赶鬼，我们就禁止他，因为他不与我们一同跟从[你]。」
9.en: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「不要禁止他；因为不敌挡你们的，就是帮助你们的。」
9.en: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

9.zh: 耶稣被接上升的日子将到，他就定意向耶路撒冷去，
9.en: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

9.zh: 便打发使者在他前头走。他们到了撒马利亚的一个村庄，要为他预备。
9.en: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

9.zh: 那里的人不接待他，因他面向耶路撒冷去。
9.en: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

9.zh: 他的门徒雅各、约翰看见了，就说：「主啊，你要我们吩咐火从天上降下来烧灭他们，像以利亚所做的吗？」
9.en: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

9.zh: 耶稣转身责备两个门徒，说：「你们的心如何，你们并不知道。
9.en: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

9.zh: 人子来不是要灭人的性命，是要救人的性命。」说着就往别的村庄去了。
9.en: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

9.zh: 他们走路的时候，有一人对耶稣说：「你无论往哪里去，我要跟从你。」
9.en: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「狐狸有洞，天空的飞鸟有窝，只是人子没有枕头的地方。」
9.en: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

9.zh: 又对一个人说：「跟从我来！」那人说：「主，容我先回去埋葬我的父亲。」
9.en: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「任凭死人埋葬他们的死人，你只管去传扬　神国[的道]。」
9.en: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

9.zh: 又有一人说：「主，我要跟从你，但容我先去辞别我家里的人。」
9.en: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

9.zh: 耶稣说：「手扶着犁向后看的，不配进　神的国。」
9.en: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

10.zh: 这事以后，主又设立七十个人，差遣他们两个两个地在他前面，往自己所要到的各城各地方去，
10.en: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

10.zh: 就对他们说：「要收的庄稼多，做工的人少。所以，你们当求庄稼的主打发工人出去收他的庄稼。
10.en: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

10.zh: 你们去吧！我差你们出去，如同羊羔进入狼群。
10.en: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

10.zh: 不要带钱囊，不要带口袋，不要带鞋；在路上也不要问人的安。
10.en: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

10.zh: 无论进哪一家，先要说：『愿这一家平安。』
10.en: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

10.zh: 那里若有当得平安的人，你们所求的平安就必临到那家；不然，就归与你们了。
10.en: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

10.zh: 你们要住在那家，吃喝他们所供给的，因为工人得工价是应当的；不要从这家搬到那家。
10.en: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

10.zh: 无论进哪一城，人若接待你们，给你们摆上什么，你们就吃什么。
10.en: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

10.zh: 要医治那城里的病人，对他们说：『　神的国临近你们了。』
10.en: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

10.zh: 无论进哪一城，人若不接待你们，你们就到街上去，
10.en: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

10.zh: 说：『就是你们城里的尘土黏在我们的脚上，我们也当着你们擦去。虽然如此，你们该知道　神的国临近了。』
10.en: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

10.zh: 我告诉你们，当审判的日子，所多玛所受的，比那城还容易受呢！」
10.en: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

10.zh: 「哥拉汛哪，你有祸了！伯赛大啊，你有祸了！因为在你们中间所行的异能若行在泰尔、西顿，他们早已披麻蒙灰，坐在地上悔改了。
10.en: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

10.zh: 当审判的日子，泰尔、西顿所受的，比你们还容易受呢！
10.en: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

10.zh: 迦百农啊，你已经升到天上，将来必推下阴间。」
10.en: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

10.zh: [又对门徒说]：「听从你们的就是听从我；弃绝你们的就是弃绝我；弃绝我的就是弃绝那差我来的。」
10.en: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

10.zh: 那七十个人欢欢喜喜地回来，说：「主啊！因你的名，就是鬼也服了我们。」
10.en: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

10.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我曾看见撒但从天上坠落，像闪电一样。
10.en: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

10.zh: 我已经给你们权柄可以践踏蛇和蝎子，又胜过仇敌一切的能力，断没有什么能害你们。
10.en: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

10.zh: 然而，不要因鬼服了你们就欢喜，要因你们的名记录在天上欢喜。」
10.en: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

10.zh: 正当那时，耶稣被圣灵感动就欢乐，说：「父啊，天地的主，我感谢你！因为你将这些事向聪明通达人就藏起来，向婴孩就显出来。父啊！是的，因为你的美意本是如此。
10.en: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

10.zh: 一切所有的都是我父交付我的；除了父，没有人知道子是谁；除了子和子所愿意指示的，没有人知道父是谁。」
10.en: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

10.zh: 耶稣转身暗暗地对门徒说：「看见你们所看见的，那眼睛就有福了。
10.en: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

10.zh: 我告诉你们，从前有许多先知和君王要看你们所看的，却没有看见，要听你们所听的，却没有听见。」
10.en: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

10.zh: 有一个律法师起来试探耶稣， 说：「夫子！我该做什么才可以承受永生？」
10.en: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

10.zh: 耶稣对他说：「律法上写的是什么？你念的是怎样呢？」
10.en: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

10.zh: 他回答说：「你要尽心、尽性、尽力、尽意爱主—你的　神；又要爱邻舍如同自己。」
