10.en: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

10.zh: 耶稣说：「你回答的是；你这样行，就必得[永]生。」
10.en: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

10.zh: 那人要显明自己有理，就对耶稣说：「谁是我的邻舍呢？」
10.en: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

10.zh: 耶稣回答说：「有一个人从耶路撒冷下耶利哥去，落在强盗手中。他们剥去他的衣裳，把他打个半死，就丢下他走了。
10.en: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

10.zh: 偶然有一个祭司从这条路下来，看见他就从那边过去了。
10.en: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

10.zh: 又有一个利未人来到这地方，看见他，也照样从那边过去了。
10.en: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

10.zh: 惟有一个撒马利亚人行路来到那里，看见他就动了慈心，
10.en: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

10.zh: 上前用油和酒倒在他的伤处，包裹好了，扶他骑上自己的牲口，带到店里去照应他。
10.en: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

10.zh: 第二天拿出二钱银子来，交给店主，说：『你且照应他；此外所费用的，我回来必还你。』
10.en: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

10.zh: 你想，这三个人哪一个是落在强盗手中的邻舍呢？」
10.en: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

10.zh: 他说：「是怜悯他的。」耶稣说：「你去照样行吧。」
10.en: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

10.zh: 他们走路的时候，耶稣进了一个村庄。有一个女人，名叫马大，接他到自己家里。
10.en: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

10.zh: 她有一个妹子，名叫马利亚，在耶稣脚前坐着听他的道。
10.en: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

10.zh: 马大伺候的事多，心里忙乱，就进前来，说：「主啊，我的妹子留下我一个人伺候，你不在意吗？请吩咐她来帮助我。」
10.en: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

10.zh: 耶稣回答说：「马大！马大！你为许多的事思虑烦扰，
10.en: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

10.zh: 但是不可少的只有一件；马利亚已经选择那上好的福分，是不能夺去的。」
10.en: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

11.zh: 耶稣在一个地方祷告；祷告完了，有个门徒对他说：「求主教导我们祷告，像约翰教导他的门徒。」
11.en: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

11.zh: 耶稣说：「你们祷告的时候，要说： 我们在天上的父： 愿人都尊你的名为圣。 愿你的国降临； 愿你的旨意行在地上， 如同行在天上。
11.en: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

11.zh: 我们日用的饮食， 天天赐给我们。
11.en: Give us day by day our daily bread.

11.zh: 赦免我们的罪， 因为我们也赦免凡亏欠我们的人。 不叫我们遇见试探； 救我们脱离凶恶。」
11.en: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

11.zh: 耶稣又说：「你们中间谁有一个朋友半夜到他那里去，说：『朋友！请借给我三个饼；
11.en: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

11.zh: 因为我有一个朋友行路，来到我这里，我没有什么给他摆上。』
11.en: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

11.zh: 那人在里面回答说：『不要搅扰我，门已经关闭，孩子们也同我在床上了，我不能起来给你。』
11.en: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

11.zh: 我告诉你们，虽不因他是朋友起来给他，但因他情词迫切地直求，就必起来照他所需用的给他。
11.en: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

11.zh: 我又告诉你们，你们祈求，就给你们；寻找，就寻见；叩门，就给你们开门。
11.en: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

11.zh: 因为，凡祈求的，就得着；寻找的，就寻见；叩门的，就给他开门。
11.en: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

11.zh: 你们中间作父亲的，谁有儿子求饼，反给他石头呢？求鱼，反拿蛇当鱼给他呢？
11.en: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

11.zh: 求[鸡]蛋，反给他蝎子呢？
11.en: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

11.zh: 你们虽然不好，尚且知道拿好东西给儿女；何况天父，岂不更将圣灵给求他的人吗？」
11.en: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

11.zh: 耶稣赶出一个叫人哑巴的鬼；鬼出去了，哑巴就说出话来；众人都希奇。
11.en: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

11.zh: 内中却有人说：「他是靠着鬼王别西卜赶鬼。」
11.en: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

11.zh: 又有人试探耶稣，向他求从天上来的神迹。
11.en: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

11.zh: 他晓得他们的意念，便对他们说：「凡一国自相纷争，就成为荒场；凡一家自相纷争，就必败落。
11.en: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

11.zh: 若撒但自相纷争，他的国怎能站得住呢？因为你们说我是靠着别西卜赶鬼。
11.en: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

11.zh: 我若靠着别西卜赶鬼，你们的子弟赶鬼又靠着谁呢？这样，他们就要断定你们的是非。
11.en: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

11.zh: 我若靠着　神的能力赶鬼，这就是　神的国临到你们了。
11.en: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

11.zh: 壮士披挂整齐，看守自己的住宅，他所有的都平安无事；
11.en: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

11.zh: 但有一个比他更壮的来，胜过他，就夺去他所倚靠的盔甲兵器，又分了他的赃。
11.en: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

11.zh: 不与我相合的，就是敌我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」
11.en: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

11.zh: 「污鬼离了人身，就在无水之地过来过去，寻求安歇[之处]；既寻不着，便说：『我要回到我所出来的屋里去。』
11.en: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

11.zh: 到了，就看见[里面]打扫干净，修饰好了，
11.en: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

11.zh: 便去另带了七个比自己更恶的鬼来，都进去住在那里。那人末后的景况比先前更不好了。」
11.en: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

11.zh: 耶稣正说这话的时候，众人中间有一个女人大声说：「怀你胎的和乳养你的有福了！」
11.en: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

11.zh: 耶稣说：「是，却还不如听　神之道而遵守的人有福。」
11.en: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

11.zh: 当众人聚集的时候，耶稣开讲说：「这世代是一个邪恶的世代。他们求看神迹，除了约拿的神迹以外，再没有神迹给他们看。
11.en: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

11.zh: 约拿怎样为尼尼微人成了神迹，人子也要照样为这世代的人成了神迹。
11.en: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

11.zh: 当审判的时候，南方的女王要起来定这世代的罪；因为她从地极而来，要听所罗门的智慧话。看哪，在这里有一人比所罗门更大。
11.en: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

11.zh: 当审判的时候，尼尼微人要起来定这世代的罪，因为尼尼微人听了约拿所传的就悔改了。看哪，在这里有一人比约拿更大。」
11.en: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

11.zh: 「没有人点灯放在地窨子里，或是斗底下，总是放在灯台上，使进来的人得见亮光。
11.en: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

11.zh: 你眼睛就是身上的灯。你的眼睛若了亮，全身就光明；眼睛若昏花，全身就黑暗。
11.en: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

11.zh: 所以，你要省察，恐怕你里头的光或者黑暗了。
11.en: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

11.zh: 若是你全身光明，毫无黑暗，就必全然光明，如同灯的明光照亮你。」
11.en: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

11.zh: 说话的时候，有一个法利赛人请耶稣同他吃饭，耶稣就进去坐席。
11.en: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

11.zh: 这法利赛人看见耶稣饭前不洗[手]便诧异。
11.en: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

11.zh: 主对他说：「如今你们法利赛人洗净杯盘的外面，你们里面却满了勒索和邪恶。
11.en: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

11.zh: 无知的人哪，造外面的，不也造里面吗？
11.en: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

11.zh: 只要把里面的施舍给人，凡物于你们就都洁净了。
11.en: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

11.zh: 「你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们将薄荷、芸香并各样菜蔬献上十分之一，那公义和爱　神的事反倒不行了。这原是你们当行的；那也是不可不行的。
11.en: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

11.zh: 你们法利赛人有祸了！因为你们喜爱会堂里的首位，又喜爱人在街市上问你们的安。
11.en: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

11.zh: 你们有祸了！因为你们如同不显露的坟墓，走在上面的人并不知道。」
11.en: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

11.zh: 律法师中有一个回答耶稣说：「夫子！你这样说也把我们糟蹋了。」
11.en: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

11.zh: 耶稣说：「你们律法师也有祸了！因为你们把难担的担子放在人身上，自己一个指头却不肯动。
11.en: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

11.zh: 你们有祸了！因为你们修造先知的坟墓，那先知正是你们的祖宗所杀的。
11.en: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

11.zh: 可见你们祖宗所做的事，你们又证明又喜欢；因为他们杀了先知，你们修造[先知的坟墓]。
11.en: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

11.zh: 所以　神用智慧曾说：『我要差遣先知和使徒到他们那里去，有的他们要杀害，有的他们要逼迫』，
11.en: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

11.zh: 使创世以来所流众先知血的罪都要问在这世代的人身上，
11.en: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

11.zh: 就是从亚伯的血起，直到被杀在坛和殿中间撒迦利亚的血为止。我实在告诉你们，这都要问在这世代的人身上。
11.en: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

11.zh: 你们律法师有祸了！因为你们把知识的钥匙夺了去，自己不进去，正要进去的人你们也阻挡他们。」
11.en: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

11.zh: 耶稣从那里出来，文士和法利赛人就极力地催逼他，引动他多说话，
11.en: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

11.zh: 私下窥听，要拿他的话柄。
11.en: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

12.zh: 这时，有几万人聚集，甚至彼此践踏。耶稣开讲，先对门徒说：「你们要防备法利赛人的酵，就是假冒为善。
12.en: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

12.zh: 掩盖的事没有不露出来的；隐藏的事没有不被人知道的。
12.en: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

12.zh: 因此，你们在暗中所说的，将要在明处被人听见；在内室附耳所说的，将要在房上被人宣扬。」
12.en: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

12.zh: 「我的朋友，我对你们说，那杀身体以后不能再做什么的，不要怕他们。
12.en: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

12.zh: 我要指示你们当怕的是谁：当怕那杀了以后又有权柄丢在地狱里的。我实在告诉你们，正要怕他。
12.en: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

12.zh: 五个麻雀不是卖二分银子吗？但在　神面前，一个也不忘记；
12.en: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

12.zh: 就是你们的头发，也都被数过了。不要惧怕，你们比许多麻雀还贵重！」
12.en: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

12.zh: 「我又告诉你们，凡在人面前认我的，人子在　神的使者面前也必认他；
12.en: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

12.zh: 在人面前不认我的，人子在　神的使者面前也必不认他。
12.en: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

12.zh: 凡说话干犯人子的，还可得赦免；惟独亵渎圣灵的，总不得赦免。
12.en: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

12.zh: 人带你们到会堂，并官府和有权柄的人面前，不要思虑怎么分诉，说什么话；
12.en: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

12.zh: 因为正在那时候，圣灵要指教你们当说的话。」
12.en: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

12.zh: 众人中有一个人对耶稣说：「夫子！请你吩咐我的兄长和我分开家业。」
12.en: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

12.zh: 耶稣说：「你这个人！谁立我作你们断事的官，给你们分家业呢？」
12.en: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

12.zh: 于是对众人说：「你们要谨慎自守，免去一切的贪心，因为人的生命不在乎家道丰富。」
12.en: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

12.zh: 就用比喻对他们说：「有一个财主田产丰盛；
12.en: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

12.zh: 自己心里思想说：『我的出产没有地方收藏，怎么办呢？』
12.en: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

12.zh: 又说：『我要这么办：要把我的仓房拆了，另盖更大的，在那里好收藏我一切的粮食和财物，
12.en: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

12.zh: 然后要对我的灵魂说：灵魂哪，你有许多财物积存，可作多年的费用，只管安安逸逸地吃喝快乐吧！』
12.en: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

12.zh: 神却对他说：『无知的人哪，今夜必要你的灵魂；你所预备的要归谁呢？』
12.en: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

12.zh: 凡为自己积财，在　神面前却不富足的，也是这样。」
12.en: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

12.zh: 耶稣又对门徒说：「所以我告诉你们，不要为生命忧虑吃什么，为身体忧虑穿什么；
12.en: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

12.zh: 因为生命胜于饮食，身体胜于衣裳。
12.en: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

12.zh: 你想乌鸦，也不种也不收，又没有仓又没有库，　神尚且养活它。你们比飞鸟是何等地贵重呢！
12.en: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

12.zh: 你们哪一个能用思虑使寿数多加一刻呢？
12.en: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

12.zh: 这最小的事，你们尚且不能做，为什么还忧虑其余的事呢？
12.en: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

12.zh: 你想百合花怎么长起来；它也不劳苦，也不纺线。然而我告诉你们，就是所罗门极荣华的时候，他所穿戴的，还不如这花一朵呢！
12.en: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

12.zh: 你们这小信的人哪，野地里的草今天还在，明天就丢在炉里，　神还给它这样的妆饰，何况你们呢！
12.en: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

12.zh: 你们不要求吃什么，喝什么，也不要挂心；
12.en: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

12.zh: 这都是外邦人所求的。你们必须用这些东西，你们的父是知道的。
12.en: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

12.zh: 你们只要求他的国，这些东西就必加给你们了。
12.en: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

12.zh: 你们这小群，不要惧怕，因为你们的父乐意把国赐给你们。
12.en: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

12.zh: 你们要变卖所有的周济人，为自己预备永不坏的钱囊，用不尽的财宝在天上，就是贼不能近、虫不能蛀的地方。
12.en: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

12.zh: 因为，你们的财宝在哪里，你们的心也在那里。」
12.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

12.zh: 「你们腰里要束上带，灯也要点着，
12.en: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

12.zh: 自己好像[仆]人等候主人从婚姻的筵席上回来。他来到，叩门，就立刻给他开门。
12.en: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

12.zh: 主人来了，看见仆人警醒，那仆人就有福了。我实在告诉你们，主人必叫他们坐席，自己束上带，进前伺候他们。
12.en: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

12.zh: 或是二更天来，或是三更天来，看见仆人这样，那仆人就有福了。
12.en: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

12.zh: 家主若知道贼什么时候来，就必警醒，不容贼挖透房屋，这是你们所知道的。
12.en: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

12.zh: 你们也要预备；因为你们想不到的时候，人子就来了。」
12.en: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

12.zh: 彼得说：「主啊，这比喻是为我们说的呢？还是为众人呢？」
12.en: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

12.zh: 主说：「谁是那忠心有见识的管家，主人派他管理家里的人，按时分粮给他们呢？
12.en: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

12.zh: 主人来到，看见仆人这样行，那仆人就有福了。
12.en: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

12.zh: 我实在告诉你们，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
12.en: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

12.zh: 那仆人若心里说：『我的主人必来得迟』，就动手打仆人和使女，并且吃喝醉酒；
12.en: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

12.zh: 在他想不到的日子，不知道的时辰，那仆人的主人要来，重重地处治他，定他和不忠心的人同罪。
12.en: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

12.zh: 仆人知道主人的意思，却不预备，又不顺他的意思行，那仆人必多受责打；
12.en: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

12.zh: 惟有那不知道的，做了当受责打的事，必少受责打；因为多给谁，就向谁多取；多托谁，就向谁多要。」
12.en: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

12.zh: 「我来要把火丢在地上，倘若已经着起来，不也是我所愿意的吗？
12.en: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

12.zh: 我有当受的洗还没有成就，我是何等地迫切呢？
12.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

12.zh: 你们以为我来，是叫地上太平吗？我告诉你们，不是，乃是叫人纷争。
12.en: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

12.zh: 从今以后，一家五个人将要纷争：三个人和两个人相争，两个人和三个人相争；
12.en: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

12.zh: 父亲和儿子相争， 儿子和父亲相争； 母亲和女儿相争， 女儿和母亲相争； 婆婆和媳妇相争， 媳妇和婆婆相争。」
12.en: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

12.zh: 耶稣又对众人说：「你们看见西边起了云彩，就说：『要下一阵雨』；果然就有。
12.en: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

12.zh: 起了南风，就说：『将要燥热』；也就有了。
12.en: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

12.zh: 假冒为善的人哪，你们知道分辨天地的气色，怎么不知道分辨这时候呢？」
12.en: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

12.zh: 「你们又为何不自己审量什么是合理的呢？
12.en: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

12.zh: 你同[告]你的对头去见官，还在路上，务要尽力地和他了结；恐怕他拉你到官面前，官交付差役，差役把你下在监里。
12.en: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

12.zh: 我告诉你，若有半文钱没有还清，你断不能从那里出来。」
12.en: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”

13.zh: 正当那时，有人将彼拉多使加利利人的血搀杂在他们祭物中的事告诉耶稣。
13.en: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

13.zh: 耶稣说：「你们以为这些加利利人比众加利利人更有罪，所以受这害吗？
13.en: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

13.zh: 我告诉你们，不是的！你们若不悔改，都要如此灭亡！
13.en: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

13.zh: 从前西罗亚楼倒塌了，压死十八个人；你们以为那些人比一切住在耶路撒冷的人更有罪吗？
13.en: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

13.zh: 我告诉你们，不是的！你们若不悔改，都要如此灭亡！」
13.en: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

13.zh: 于是用比喻说：「一个人有一棵无花果树栽在葡萄园里。他来到树前找果子，却找不着。
13.en: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.

13.zh: 就对管园的说：『看哪，我这三年来到这无花果树前找果子，竟找不着。把它砍了吧，何必白占地土呢！』
13.en: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

13.zh: 管园的说：『主啊，今年且留着，等我周围掘开土，加上粪；
13.en: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

13.zh: 以后若结果子便罢，不然再把它砍了。』」
13.en: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

13.zh: 安息日，耶稣在会堂里教训人。
13.en: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

13.zh: 有一个女人被鬼附着，病了十八年，腰弯得一点直不起来。
13.en: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

13.zh: 耶稣看见，便叫过她来，对她说：「女人，你脱离这病了！」
13.en: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

13.zh: 于是用两只手按着她；她立刻直起腰来，就归荣耀与　神。
13.en: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

13.zh: 管会堂的因为耶稣在安息日治病，就气忿忿地对众人说：「有六日应当做工；那六日之内可以来求医，在安息日却不可。」
13.en: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

13.zh: 主说：「假冒为善的人哪，难道你们各人在安息日不解开槽上的牛、驴，牵去饮吗？
13.en: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

13.zh: 况且这女人本是亚伯拉罕的后裔，被撒但捆绑了这十八年，不当在安息日解开她的绑吗？」
13.en: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

13.zh: 耶稣说这话，他的敌人都惭愧了；众人因他所行一切荣耀的事，就都欢喜了。
13.en: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

13.zh: 耶稣说：「　神的国好像什么？我拿什么来比较呢？
13.en: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

13.zh: 好像一粒芥菜种，有人拿去种在园子里，长大成树，天上的飞鸟宿在它的枝上。」
13.en: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

13.zh: 又说：「我拿什么来比　神的国呢？
13.en: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

13.zh: 好比面酵，有妇人拿来藏在三斗面里，直等全团都发起来。」
13.en: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

13.zh: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，在所经过的各城各乡教训人。
13.en: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

13.zh: 有一个人问他说：「主啊，得救的人少吗？」
13.en: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

13.zh: 耶稣对众人说：「你们要努力进窄门。我告诉你们，将来有许多人想要进去，却是不能。
13.en: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

13.zh: 及至家主起来关了门，你们站在外面叩门，说：『主啊，给我们开门！』他就回答说：『我不认识你们，不晓得你们是哪里来的！』
13.en: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

13.zh: 那时，你们要说：『我们在你面前吃过喝过，你也在我们的街上教训过人。』
13.en: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

13.zh: 他要说：『我告诉你们，我不晓得你们是哪里来的。你们这一切作恶的人，离开我去吧！』
13.en: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

13.zh: 你们要看见亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各，和众先知都在　神的国里，你们却被赶到外面，在那里必要哀哭切齿了。
13.en: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

13.zh: 从东、从西、从南、从北将有人来，在　神的国里坐席。
13.en: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

13.zh: 只是有在后的，将要在前；有在前的，将要在后。」
13.en: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

13.zh: 正当那时，有几个法利赛人来对耶稣说：「离开这里去吧，因为希律想要杀你。」
13.en: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

13.zh: 耶稣说：「你们去告诉那个狐狸说：『今天、明天我赶鬼治病，第三天我的事就成全了。』
13.en: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

13.zh: 虽然这样，今天、明天、后天，我必须前行，因为先知在耶路撒冷之外丧命是不能的。
13.en: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

13.zh: 耶路撒冷啊！耶路撒冷啊！你常杀害先知，又用石头打死那奉差遣到你这里来的人。我多次愿意聚集你的儿女，好像母鸡把小鸡聚集在翅膀底下；只是你们不愿意。
13.en: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

13.zh: 看哪，你们的家成为荒场留给你们。我告诉你们，[从今以后]你们不得再见我，直等到你们说：『奉主名来的是应当称颂的。』」
13.en: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

14.zh: 安息日，耶稣到一个法利赛人的首领家里去吃饭，他们就窥探他。
14.en: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

14.zh: 在他面前有一个患水臌的人。
14.en: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

14.zh: 耶稣对律法师和法利赛人说：「安息日治病可以不可以？」
14.en: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

14.zh: 他们却不言语。耶稣就治好那人，叫他走了；
14.en: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

14.zh: 便对他们说：「你们中间谁有驴或有牛，在安息日掉在井里，不立时拉它上来呢？」
14.en: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

14.zh: 他们不能对答这话。
14.en: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

14.zh: 耶稣见所请的客拣择首位，就用比喻对他们说：
14.en: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

14.zh: 「你被人请去赴婚姻的筵席，不要坐在首位上，恐怕有比你尊贵的客被他请来；
14.en: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

14.zh: 那请你们的人前来对你说：『让座给这一位吧！』你就羞羞惭惭地退到末位上去了。
14.en: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

14.zh: 你被请的时候，就去坐在末位上，好叫那请你的人来对你说：『朋友，请上座。』那时，你在同席的人面前就有光彩了。
14.en: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

14.zh: 因为，凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。」
14.en: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

14.zh: 耶稣又对请他的人说：「你摆设午饭或晚饭，不要请你的朋友、弟兄、亲属，和富足的邻舍，恐怕他们也请你，你就得了报答。
14.en: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

14.zh: 你摆设筵席，倒要请那贫穷的、残废的、瘸腿的、瞎眼的，你就有福了！
14.en: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

14.zh: 因为他们没有什么可报答你。到义人复活的时候，你要得着报答。」
14.en: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

14.zh: 同席的有一人听见这话，就对耶稣说：「在　神国里吃饭的有福了！」
14.en: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

14.zh: 耶稣对他说：「有一人摆设大筵席，请了许多客。
14.en: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

14.zh: 到了坐席的时候，打发仆人去对所请的人说：『请来吧！样样都齐备了。』
14.en: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

14.zh: 众人一口同音地推辞。头一个说：『我买了一块地，必须去看看。请你准我辞了。』
14.en: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

14.zh: 又有一个说：『我买了五对牛，要去试一试。请你准我辞了。』
14.en: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

14.zh: 又有一个说：『我才娶了妻，所以不能去。』
14.en: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

14.zh: 那仆人回来，把这事都告诉了主人。家主就动怒，对仆人说：『快出去，到城里大街小巷，领那贫穷的、残废的、瞎眼的、瘸腿的来。』
14.en: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

14.zh: 仆人说：『主啊，你所吩咐的已经办了，还有空座。』
14.en: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

14.zh: 主人对仆人说：『你出去到路上和篱笆那里，勉强人进来，坐满我的屋子。
14.en: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

14.zh: 我告诉你们，先前所请的人没有一个得尝我的筵席。』」
14.en: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

14.zh: 有极多的人和耶稣同行。他转过来对他们说：
14.en: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

14.zh: 「人到我这里来，若不爱我胜过爱自己的父 母、妻子、儿女、弟兄、姊妹，和自己的性命，就不能作我的门徒。
14.en: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

14.zh: 凡不背着自己十字架跟从我的，也不能作我的门徒。
14.en: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

14.zh: 你们哪一个要盖一座楼，不先坐下算计花费，能盖成不能呢？
14.en: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

14.zh: 恐怕安了地基，不能成功，看见的人都笑话他，说：
14.en: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

14.zh: 『这个人开了工，却不能完工。』
14.en: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

14.zh: 或是一个王出去和别的王打仗，岂不先坐下酌量，能用一万兵去敌那领二万兵来攻打他的吗？
14.en: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

14.zh: 若是不能，就趁敌人还远的时候，派使者去求和息的条款。
14.en: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

14.zh: 这样，你们无论什么人，若不撇下一切所有的，就不能作我的门徒。」
14.en: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

14.zh: 「盐本是好的；盐若失了味，可用什么叫它再咸呢？
14.en: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

14.zh: 或用在田里，或堆在粪里，都不合式，只好丢在外面。有耳可听的，就应当听！」
14.en: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

15.zh: 众税吏和罪人都挨近耶稣，要听他[讲道]。
15.en: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

15.zh: 法利赛人和文士私下议论说：「这个人接待罪人，又同他们吃饭。」
15.en: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

15.zh: 耶稣就用比喻说：
15.en: He told them this parable:

15.zh: 「你们中间谁有一百只羊失去一只，不把这九十九只撇在旷野、去找那失去的羊，直到找着呢？
15.en: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

15.zh: 找着了，就欢欢喜喜地扛在肩上，回到家里，
15.en: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

15.zh: 就请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：『我失去的羊已经找着了，你们和我一同欢喜吧！』
15.en: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

15.zh: 我告诉你们，一个罪人悔改，在天上也要这样为他欢喜，较比为九十九个不用悔改的义人欢喜更大。」
15.en: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

15.zh: 「或是一个妇人有十块钱，若失落一块，岂不点上灯，打扫屋子，细细地找，直到找着吗？
15.en: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

15.zh: 找着了，就请朋友邻舍来，对他们说：『我失落的那块钱已经找着了，你们和我一同欢喜吧！』
15.en: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

15.zh: 我告诉你们，一个罪人悔改，在　神的使者面前也是这样为他欢喜。」
15.en: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

15.zh: 耶稣又说：「一个人有两个儿子。
15.en: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

15.zh: 小儿子对父亲说：『父亲，请你把我应得的家业分给我。』他父亲就把产业分给他们。
15.en: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

15.zh: 过了不多几日，小儿子就把他一切所有的都收拾起来，往远方去了。在那里任意放荡，浪费资财。
15.en: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

15.zh: 既耗尽了一切所有的，又遇着那地方大遭饥荒，就穷苦起来。
15.en: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

15.zh: 于是去投靠那地方的一个人；那人打发他到田里去放猪。
15.en: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

15.zh: 他恨不得拿猪所吃的豆荚充饥，也没有人给他。
15.en: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

15.zh: 他醒悟过来，就说：『我父亲有多少的雇工，口粮有余，我倒在这里饿死吗？
15.en: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

15.zh: 我要起来，到我父亲那里去，向他说：父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；
15.en: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

15.zh: 从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子，把我当作一个雇工吧！』
15.en: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

15.zh: 于是起来，往他父亲那里去。相离还远，他父亲看见，就动了慈心，跑去抱着他的颈项，连连与他亲嘴。
15.en: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

15.zh: 儿子说：『父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子。』
15.en: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

15.zh: 父亲却吩咐仆人说：『把那上好的袍子快拿出来给他穿；把戒指戴在他指头上；把鞋穿在他脚上；
15.en: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

15.zh: 把那肥牛犊牵来宰了，我们可以吃喝快乐；
15.en: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

15.zh: 因为我这个儿子是死而复活，失而又得的。』他们就快乐起来。
15.en: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

15.zh: 那时，大儿子正在田里。他回来，离家不远，听见作乐跳舞的声音，
15.en: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

15.zh: 便叫过一个仆人来，问是什么事。
15.en: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

15.zh: 仆人说：『你兄弟来了；你父亲因为得他无灾无病地回来，把肥牛犊宰了。』
15.en: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

15.zh: 大儿子却生气，不肯进去；他父亲就出来劝他。
15.en: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

15.zh: 他对父亲说：『我服事你这多年，从来没有违背过你的命，你并没有给我一只山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快乐。
15.en: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

15.zh: 但你这个儿子和娼妓吞尽了你的产业，他一来了，你倒为他宰了肥牛犊。』
15.en: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

15.zh: 父亲对他说：『儿啊！你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；
15.en: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

15.zh: 只是你这个兄弟是死而复活、失而又得的，所以我们理当欢喜快乐。』」
15.en: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

16.zh: 耶稣又对门徒说：「有一个财主的管家，别人向他主人告他浪费主人的财物。
16.en: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

16.zh: 主人叫他来，对他说：『我听见你这事怎么样呢？把你所经管的交代明白，因你不能再作[我的]管家。』
16.en: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

16.zh: 那管家心里说：『主人辞我，不用我再作管家，我将来做什么？锄地呢？无力；讨饭呢？怕羞。
16.en: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

16.zh: 我知道怎么行，好叫人在我不作管家之后，接我到他们家里去。』
16.en: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

16.zh: 于是把欠他主人债的，一个一个地叫了来，问头一个说：『你欠我主人多少？』
16.en: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

16.zh: 他说：『一百篓油。』管家说：『拿你的帐，快坐下，写五十。』
16.en: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

16.zh: 又问一个说：『你欠多少？』他说：『一百石麦子。』管家说：『拿你的帐，写八十。』
16.en: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

16.zh: 主人就夸奖这不义的管家做事聪明；因为今世之子，在世事之上，较比光明之子更加聪明。
16.en: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

16.zh: 我又告诉你们，要借着那不义的钱财结交朋友，到了钱财无用的时候，他们可以接你们到永存的帐幕里去。
16.en: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

16.zh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。
16.en: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

16.zh: 倘若你们在不义的钱财上不忠心，谁还把那真实的[钱财]托付你们呢？
16.en: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

16.zh: 倘若你们在别人的东西上不忠心，谁还把你们自己的东西给你们呢？
16.en: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

16.zh: 一个仆人不能事奉两个主；不是恶这个爱那个，就是重这个轻那个。你们不能又事奉　神，又事奉玛门。」
16.en: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

16.zh: 法利赛人是贪爱钱财的；他们听见这一切话，就嗤笑耶稣。
16.en: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

16.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们是在人面前自称为义的，你们的心，　神却知道；因为人所尊贵的，是　神看为可憎恶的。
16.en: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

16.zh: 律法和先知到约翰为止，从此　神国的福音传开了，人人努力要进去。
16.en: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

16.zh: 天地废去较比律法的一点一画落空还容易。
16.en: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

16.zh: 凡休妻另娶的就是犯奸淫；娶被休之妻的也是犯奸淫。」
16.en: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

16.zh: 「有一个财主穿着紫色[袍]和细麻布衣服，天天奢华宴乐。
16.en: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

16.zh: 又有一个讨饭的，名叫拉撒路，浑身生疮，被人放在财主门口，
16.en: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

16.zh: 要得财主桌子上掉下来的[零碎]充饥，并且狗来舔他的疮。
16.en: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

16.zh: 后来那讨饭的死了，被天使带去放在亚伯拉罕的怀里。财主也死了，并且埋葬了。
16.en: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

16.zh: 他在阴间受痛苦，举目远远地望见亚伯拉罕，又望见拉撒路在他怀里，
16.en: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

16.zh: 就喊着说：『我祖亚伯拉罕哪，可怜我吧！打发拉撒路来，用指头尖蘸点水，凉凉我的舌头；因为我在这火焰里，极其痛苦。』
16.en: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

16.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：『儿啊，你该回想你生前享过福，拉撒路也受过苦；如今他在这里得安慰，你倒受痛苦。
16.en: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

16.zh: 不但这样，并且在你我之间，有深渊限定，以致人要从这边过到你们那边是不能的；要从那边过到我们这边也是不能的。』
16.en: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

16.zh: 财主说：『我祖啊！既是这样，求你打发拉撒路到我父家去；
16.en: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

16.zh: 因为我还有五个弟兄，他可以对他们作见证，免得他们也来到这痛苦的地方。』
16.en: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

16.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：『他们有摩西和先知[的话]可以听从。』
16.en: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

16.zh: 他说：『我祖亚伯拉罕哪，不是的，若有一个从死里[复活的]，到他们那里去的，他们必要悔改。』
16.en: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

16.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：『若不听从摩西和先知[的话]，就是有一个从死里复活的，他们也是不听劝。』」
16.en: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

17.zh: 耶稣又对门徒说：「绊倒人的事是免不了的；但那绊倒人的有祸了。
17.en: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

17.zh: 就是把磨石拴在这人的颈项上，丢在海里，还强如他把这小子里的一个绊倒了。
17.en: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

17.zh: 你们要谨慎！若是你的弟兄得罪[你]，就劝戒他；他若懊悔，就饶恕他。
17.en: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

17.zh: 倘若他一天七次得罪你，又七次回转，说：『我懊悔了』，你总要饶恕他。」
17.en: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

17.zh: 使徒对主说：「[求主]加增我们的信心。」
17.en: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

17.zh: 主说：「你们若有信心像一粒芥菜种，就是对这棵桑树说：『你要拔起根来，栽在海里』，它也必听从你们。
17.en: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

17.zh: 你们谁有仆人耕地或是放羊，从田里回来，就对他说：『你快来坐下吃饭』呢？
17.en: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

17.zh: 岂不对他说：『你给我预备晚饭，束上带子伺候我，等我吃喝完了，你才可以吃喝』吗？
17.en: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

17.zh: 仆人照所吩咐的去做，主人还谢谢他吗？
17.en: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

17.zh: 这样，你们做完了一切所吩咐的，只当说：『我们是无用的仆人，所做的本是我们应分做的。』」
17.en: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

17.zh: 耶稣往耶路撒冷去，经过撒马利亚和加利利。
17.en: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

17.zh: 进入一个村子，有十个长大麻风的，迎面而来，远远地站着，
17.en: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

17.zh: 高声说：「耶稣，夫子，可怜我们吧！」
17.en: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

17.zh: 耶稣看见，就对他们说：「你们去把身体给祭司察看。」他们去的时候就洁净了。
17.en: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

17.zh: 内中有一个见自己已经好了，就回来大声归荣耀与　神，
17.en: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

17.zh: 又俯伏在耶稣脚前感谢他；这人是撒马利亚人。
17.en: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

17.zh: 耶稣说：「洁净了的不是十个人吗？那九个在哪里呢？
17.en: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

17.zh: 除了这外族人，再没有别人回来归荣耀与　神吗？」
17.en: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

17.zh: 就对那人说：「起来，走吧！你的信救了你了。」
17.en: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

17.zh: 法利赛人问：「　神的国几时来到？」耶稣回答说：「　神的国来到不是眼所能见的。
17.en: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

17.zh: 人也不得说：『看哪，在这里！看哪，在那里！』因为　神的国就在你们心里。」
17.en: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

17.zh: 他又对门徒说：「日子将到，你们巴不得看见人子的一个日子，却不得看见。
17.en: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

17.zh: 人将要对你们说：『看哪，在那里！看哪，在这里！』你们不要出去，也不要跟随他们！
17.en: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

17.zh: 因为人子在他[降临]的日子，好像闪电从天这边一闪直照到天那边。
17.en: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

17.zh: 只是他必须先受许多苦，又被这世代弃绝。
17.en: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

17.zh: 挪亚的日子怎样，人子的日子也要怎样。
17.en: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

17.zh: 那时候的人又吃又喝，又娶又嫁，到挪亚进方舟的那日，洪水就来，把他们全都灭了。
17.en: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

17.zh: 又好像罗得的日子；人又吃又喝，又买又卖，又耕种又盖造。
17.en: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

17.zh: 到罗得出所多玛的那日，就有火与硫磺从天上降下来，把他们全都灭了。
17.en: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

17.zh: 人子显现的日子也要这样。
17.en: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

17.zh: 当那日，人在房上，器具在屋里，不要下来拿；人在田里，也不要回家。
17.en: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

17.zh: 你们要回想罗得的妻子。
17.en: Remember Lot’s wife!

17.zh: 凡想要保全生命的，必丧掉生命；凡丧掉生命的，必救活生命。
17.en: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

17.zh: 我对你们说，当那一夜，两个人在一个床上，要取去一个，撇下一个。
17.en: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

17.zh: 两个女人一同推磨，要取去一个，撇下一个。」
17.en: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

17.zh: 门徒说：「主啊，在哪里[有这事]呢？」耶稣说：「尸首在哪里，鹰也必聚在那里。」
17.en: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

18.zh: 耶稣设一个比喻，是要人常常祷告，不可灰心。
18.en: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

18.zh: 说：「某城里有一个官，不惧怕　神，也不尊重世人。
18.en: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

18.zh: 那城里有个寡妇，常到他那里，说：『我有一个对头，求你给我伸冤。』
18.en: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

18.zh: 他多日不准，后来心里说：『我虽不惧怕　神，也不尊重世人，
18.en: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

18.zh: 只因这寡妇烦扰我，我就给她伸冤吧，免得她常来缠磨我！』」
18.en: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

18.zh: 主说：「你们听这不义之官所说的话。
18.en: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

18.zh: 神的选民昼夜呼吁他，他纵然为他们忍了多时，岂不终久给他们伸冤吗？
18.en: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

18.zh: 我告诉你们，要快快地给他们伸冤了。然而，人子来的时候，遇得见世上有信德吗？」
18.en: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

18.zh: 耶稣向那些仗着自己是义人，藐视别人的，设一个比喻，
18.en: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

18.zh: 说：「有两个人上殿里去祷告：一个是法利赛人，一个是税吏。
18.en: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

18.zh: 法利赛人站着，自言自语地祷告说：『　神啊，我感谢你，我不像别人勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。
18.en: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

18.zh: 我一个礼拜禁食两次，凡我所得的都捐上十分之一。』
18.en: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

18.zh: 那税吏远远地站着，连举目望天也不敢，只捶着胸说：『　神啊，开恩可怜我这个罪人！』
18.en: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

18.zh: 我告诉你们，这人回家去比那人倒算为义了；因为，凡自高的，必降为卑；自卑的，必升为高。」
18.en: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

18.zh: 有人抱着自己的婴孩来见耶稣，要他摸他们；门徒看见就责备那些人。
18.en: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

18.zh: 耶稣却叫他们来，说：「让小孩子到我这里来，不要禁止他们，因为在　神国的正是这样的人。
18.en: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

18.zh: 我实在告诉你们，凡要承受　神国的，若不像小孩子，断不能进去。」
18.en: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

18.zh: 有一个官问耶稣说：「良善的夫子，我该做什么事才可以承受永生？」
18.en: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

18.zh: 耶稣对他说：「你为什么称我是良善的？除了　神一位之外，再没有良善的。
18.en: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

18.zh: 诫命你是晓得的：『不可奸淫；不可杀人；不可偷盗；不可作假见证；当孝敬父母。』」
18.en: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

18.zh: 那人说：「这一切我从小都遵守了。」
18.en: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

18.zh: 耶稣听见了，就说：「你还缺少一件：要变卖你一切所有的，分给穷人，就必有财宝在天上；你还要来跟从我。」
18.en: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

18.zh: 他听见这话，就甚忧愁，因为他很富足。
18.en: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

18.zh: 耶稣看见他，就说：「有钱财的人进　神的国是何等的难哪！
18.en: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

18.zh: 骆驼穿过针的眼比财主进　神的国还容易呢！」
18.en: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

18.zh: 听见的人说：「这样，谁能得救呢？」
18.en: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

18.zh: 耶稣说：「在人所不能的事，在　神却能。」
18.en: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

18.zh: 彼得说：「看哪，我们已经撇下自己所有的跟从你了。」
18.en: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

18.zh: 耶稣说：「我实在告诉你们，人为　神的国撇下房屋，或是妻子、弟兄、父母、儿女，
18.en: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

18.zh: 没有在今世不得百倍，在来世不得永生的。」
18.en: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

18.zh: 耶稣带着十二个门徒，对他们说：「看哪，我们上耶路撒冷去，先知所写的一切事都要成就在人子身上。
18.en: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

18.zh: 他将要被交给外邦人；他们要戏弄他，凌辱他，吐唾沫在他脸上，
18.en: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

18.zh: 并要鞭打他，杀害他；第三日他要复活。」
18.en: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

18.zh: 这些事门徒一样也不懂得，意思乃是隐藏的；他们不晓得所说的是什么。
18.en: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

18.zh: 耶稣将近耶利哥的时候，有一个瞎子坐在路旁讨饭。
18.en: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

18.zh: 听见许多人经过，就问是什么事。
18.en: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

18.zh: 他们告诉他，是拿撒勒人耶稣经过。
18.en: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

18.zh: 他就呼叫说：「大卫的子孙耶稣啊，可怜我吧！」
18.en: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

18.zh: 在前头走的人就责备他，不许他作声；他却越发喊叫说：「大卫的子孙，可怜我吧！」
18.en: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

18.zh: 耶稣站住，吩咐把他领过来，到了跟前，就问他说：
18.en: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

18.zh: 「你要我为你做什么？」他说：「主啊，我要能看见。」
18.en: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

18.zh: 耶稣说：「你可以看见！你的信救了你了。」
18.en: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

18.zh: 瞎子立刻看见了，就跟随耶稣，[一路]归荣耀与　神。众人看见这事，也赞美　神。
18.en: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

19.zh: 耶稣进了耶利哥，正经过的时候，
19.en: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

19.zh: 有一个人名叫撒该，作税吏长，是个财主。
19.en: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

19.zh: 他要看看耶稣是怎样的人；只因人多，他的身量又矮，所以不得看见，
19.en: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

19.zh: 就跑到前头，爬上桑树，要看耶稣，因为耶稣必从那里经过。
19.en: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

19.zh: 耶稣到了那里，抬头一看，对他说：「撒该，快下来！今天我必住在你家里。」
19.en: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

19.zh: 他就急忙下来，欢欢喜喜地接待耶稣。
19.en: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

19.zh: 众人看见，都私下议论说：「他竟到罪人家里去住宿。」
19.en: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

19.zh: 撒该站着对主说：「主啊，我把所有的一半给穷人；我若讹诈了谁，就还他四倍。」
19.en: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

19.zh: 耶稣说：「今天救恩到了这家，因为他也是亚伯拉罕的子孙。
19.en: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

19.zh: 人子来，为要寻找、拯救失丧的人。」
19.en: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

19.zh: 众人正在听见这些话的时候，耶稣因为将近耶路撒冷，又因他们以为　神的国快要显出来，就另设一个比喻，说：
19.en: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

19.zh: 「有一个贵胄往远方去，要得国回来，
19.en: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

19.zh: 便叫了他的十个仆人来，交给他们十锭银子，说：『你们去做生意，直等我回来。』
19.en: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

19.zh: 他本国的人却恨他，打发使者随后去，说：『我们不愿意这个人作我们的王。』
19.en: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

19.zh: 他既得国回来，就吩咐叫那领银子的仆人来，要知道他们做生意赚了多少。
19.en: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

19.zh: 头一个上来，说：『主啊，你的一锭银子已经赚了十锭。』
19.en: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

19.zh: 主人说：『好！良善的仆人，你既在最小的事上有忠心，可以有权柄管十座城。』
19.en: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

19.zh: 第二个来，说：『主啊，你的一锭银子已经赚了五锭。』
19.en: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

19.zh: 主人说：『你也可以管五座城。』
19.en: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

19.zh: 又有一个来说：『主啊，看哪，你的一锭银子在这里，我把它包在手巾里存着。
19.en: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

19.zh: 我原是怕你，因为你是严厉的人；没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收。』
19.en: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

19.zh: 主人对他说：『你这恶仆，我要凭你的口定你的罪。你既知道我是严厉的人，没有放下的，还要去拿，没有种下的，还要去收，
19.en: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

19.zh: 为什么不把我的银子交给银行，等我来的时候，连本带利都可以要回来呢？』
19.en: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

19.zh: 就对旁边站着的人说：『夺过他这一锭来，给那有十锭的。』
19.en: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

19.zh: 他们说：『主啊，他已经有十锭了。』
19.en: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

19.zh: [主人说]：『我告诉你们，凡有的，还要加给他；没有的，连他所有的也要夺过来。
19.en: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

19.zh: 至于我那些仇敌，不要我作他们王的，把他们拉来，在我面前杀了吧！』」
19.en: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

19.zh: 耶稣说完了这话，就在前面走，上耶路撒冷去。
19.en: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

19.zh: 将近伯法其和伯大尼，在一座山名叫橄榄山那里，就打发两个门徒，说：
19.en: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

19.zh: 「你们往对面村子里去，进去的时候，必看见一匹驴驹拴在那里，是从来没有人骑过的，可以解开牵来。
19.en: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

19.zh: 若有人问为什么解它，你们就说：『主要用它。』」
19.en: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

19.zh: 打发的人去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的。
19.en: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

19.zh: 他们解驴驹的时候，主人问他们说：「解驴驹做什么？」
19.en: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

19.zh: 他们说：「主要用它。」
19.en: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

19.zh: 他们牵到耶稣那里，把自己的衣服搭在上面，扶着耶稣骑上。
19.en: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

19.zh: 走的时候，众人把衣服铺在路上。
19.en: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

19.zh: 将近耶路撒冷，正下橄榄山的时候，众门徒因所见过的一切异能，都欢乐起来，大声赞美　神，
19.en: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

19.zh: 说： 奉主名来的王是应当称颂的！ 在天上有和平； 在至高之处有荣光。
19.en: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

19.zh: 众人中有几个法利赛人对耶稣说：「夫子，责备你的门徒吧！」
19.en: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

19.zh: 耶稣说：「我告诉你们，若是他们闭口不说，这些石头必要呼叫起来。」
19.en: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

19.zh: 耶稣快到耶路撒冷，看见城，就为它哀哭，
19.en: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

19.zh: 说：「巴不得你在这日子知道关系你平安的事；无奈这事现在是隐藏的，叫你的眼看不出来。
19.en: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

19.zh: 因为日子将到，你的仇敌必筑起土垒，周围环绕你，四面困住你，
19.en: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

19.zh: 并要扫灭你和你里头的儿女，连一块石头也不留在石头上，因你不知道眷顾你的时候。」
19.en: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

19.zh: 耶稣进了殿，赶出里头做买卖的人，
19.en: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

19.zh: 对他们说：「[经上]说： 我的殿必作祷告的殿， 你们倒使它成为贼窝了。」
19.en: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

19.zh: 耶稣天天在殿里教训人。祭司长和文士与百姓的尊长都想要杀他，
19.en: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

19.zh: 但寻不出法子来，因为百姓都侧耳听他。
19.en: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

20.zh: 有一天，耶稣在殿里教训百姓，讲福音的时候，祭司长和文士并长老上前来，
20.en: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

20.zh: 问他说：「你告诉我们，你仗着什么权柄做这些事？给你这权柄的是谁呢？」
20.en: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

20.zh: 耶稣回答说：「我也要问你们一句话，你们且告诉我。
20.en: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

20.zh: 约翰的洗礼是从天上来的？是从人间来的呢？」
20.en: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

20.zh: 他们彼此商议说：「我们若说『从天上来』，他必说：『你们为什么不信他呢？』
20.en: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

20.zh: 若说『从人间来』，百姓都要用石头打死我们，因为他们信约翰是先知。」
20.en: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

20.zh: 于是回答说：「不知道是从哪里来的。」
20.en: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

20.zh: 耶稣说：「我也不告诉你们，我仗着什么权柄做这些事。」
20.en: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

20.zh: 耶稣就设比喻对百姓说：「有人栽了一个葡萄园，租给园户，就往外国去住了许久。
20.en: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

20.zh: 到了时候，打发一个仆人到园户那里去，叫他们把园中当纳的果子交给他；园户竟打了他，叫他空手回去。
20.en: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

20.zh: 又打发一个仆人去，他们也打了他，并且凌辱他，叫他空手回去。
20.en: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

20.zh: 又打发第三个仆人去，他们也打伤了他，把他推出去了。
20.en: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

20.zh: 园主说：『我怎么办呢？我要打发我的爱子去，或者他们尊敬他。』
20.en: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

20.zh: 不料，园户看见他，就彼此商量说：『这是承受产业的，我们杀他吧，使产业归于我们！』
20.en: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

20.zh: 于是把他推出葡萄园外，杀了。这样，葡萄园的主人要怎样处治他们呢？
20.en: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

20.zh: 他要来除灭这些园户，将葡萄园转给别人。」听见的人说：「这是万不可的！」
20.en: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

20.zh: 耶稣看着他们说：「[经上]记着： 匠人所弃的石头 已作了房角的头块石头。 这是什么意思呢？
20.en: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

20.zh: 凡掉在那石头上的，必要跌碎；那石头掉在谁的身上，就要把谁砸得稀烂。」
20.en: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

20.zh: 文士和祭司长看出这比喻是指着他们说的，当时就想要下手拿他，只是惧怕百姓。
20.en: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

20.zh: 于是窥探耶稣，打发奸细装作好人，要在他的话上得把柄，好将他交在巡抚的政权之下。
20.en: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

20.zh: 奸细就问耶稣说：「夫子，我们晓得你所讲所传都是正道，也不取人的外貌，乃是诚诚实实传　神的道。
20.en: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

20.zh: 我们纳税给凯撒，可以不可以？」
20.en: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

20.zh: 耶稣看出他们的诡诈，就对他们说：
20.en: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

20.zh: 「拿一个银钱来给我看。这像和这号是谁的？」他们说：「是凯撒的。」
20.en: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

20.zh: 耶稣说：「这样，凯撒的物当归给凯撒，　神的物当归给　神。」
20.en: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

20.zh: 他们当着百姓，在这话上得不着把柄，又希奇他的应对，就闭口无言了。
20.en: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

20.zh: 撒都该人常说没有复活的事。有几个来问耶稣说：
20.en: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

20.zh: 「夫子！摩西为我们写着说：『人若有妻无子就死了，他兄弟当娶他的妻，为哥哥生子立后。』
20.en: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

20.zh: 有弟兄七人，第一个娶了妻，没有孩子死了；
20.en: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

20.zh: 第二个、第三个也娶过她；
20.en: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

20.zh: 那七个人都娶过她，没有留下孩子就死了。
20.en: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

20.zh: 后来妇人也死了。
20.en: Afterward the woman also died.

20.zh: 这样，当复活的时候，她是哪一个的妻子呢？因为他们七个人都娶过她。」
20.en: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

20.zh: 耶稣说：「这世界的人有娶有嫁；
20.en: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

20.zh: 惟有算为配得那世界，与从死里复活的人也不娶也不嫁；
20.en: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

20.zh: 因为他们不能再死，和天使一样；既是复活的人，就为　神的儿子。
20.en: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

20.zh: 至于死人复活，摩西在荆棘篇上，称主是亚伯拉罕的　神，以撒的　神，雅各的　神，就指示明白了。
20.en: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

20.zh: 神原不是死人的　神，乃是活人的　神；因为在他那里，人都是活的。」
20.en: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

20.zh: 有几个文士说：「夫子！你说得好。」
20.en: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

20.zh: 以后他们不敢再问他什么。
20.en: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

20.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「人怎么说基督是大卫的子孙呢？
20.en: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

20.zh: 诗篇上大卫自己说： 主对我主说： 你坐在我的右边，
20.en: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

20.zh: 等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
20.en: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

20.zh: 大卫既称他为主，他怎么又是大卫的子孙呢？」
20.en: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

20.zh: 众百姓听的时候，耶稣对门徒说：
20.en: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

20.zh: 「你们要防备文士。他们好穿长衣游行，喜爱人在街市上问他们安，又喜爱会堂里的高位，筵席上的首座；
20.en: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

20.zh: 他们侵吞寡妇的家产，假意作很长的祷告。这些人要受更重的刑罚！」
20.en: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

21.zh: 耶稣抬头观看，见财主把捐项投在库里，
21.en: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

21.zh: 又见一个穷寡妇投了两个小钱，
21.en: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

21.zh: 就说：「我实在告诉你们，这穷寡妇所投的比众人还多；
21.en: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

21.zh: 因为众人都是自己有余，拿出来投在捐项里，但这寡妇是自己不足，把她一切养生的都投上了。」
21.en: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

21.zh: 有人谈论圣殿是用美石和供物妆饰的；
21.en: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

21.zh: 耶稣就说：「论到你们所看见的这一切，将来日子到了，在这里没有一块石头留在石头上，不被拆毁了。」
21.en: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

21.zh: 他们问他说：「夫子！什么时候有这事呢？这事将到的时候有什么预兆呢？」
21.en: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

21.zh: 耶稣说：「你们要谨慎，不要受迷惑；因为将来有好些人冒我的名来，说：『我是[基督]』，又说：『时候近了』，你们不要跟从他们！
21.en: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

21.zh: 你们听见打仗和扰乱的事，不要惊惶；因为这些事必须先有，只是末期不能立时就到。」
21.en: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

21.zh: 当时，耶稣对他们说：「民要攻打民，国要攻打国；
21.en: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

21.zh: 地要大大震动，多处必有饥荒、瘟疫，又有可怕的异象和大神迹从天上显现。
21.en: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

21.zh: 但这一切的事以先，人要下手拿住你们，逼迫你们，把你们交给会堂，并且收在监里，又为我的名拉你们到君王诸侯面前。
21.en: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

21.zh: 但这些事终必为你们的见证。
21.en: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

21.zh: 所以，你们当立定心意，不要预先思想怎样分诉；
21.en: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

21.zh: 因为我必赐你们口才、智慧，是你们一切敌人所敌不住、驳不倒的。
21.en: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

21.zh: 连你们的父母、弟兄、亲族、朋友也要把你们交官；你们也有被他们害死的。
21.en: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

21.zh: 你们要为我的名被众人恨恶，
21.en: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

21.zh: 然而，你们连一根头发也必不损坏。
21.en: And not a hair of your head will perish.

21.zh: 你们常存忍耐，就必保全灵魂。」
21.en: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

21.zh: 「你们看见耶路撒冷被兵围困，就可知道它成荒场的日子近了。
21.en: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

21.zh: 那时，在犹太的应当逃到山上；在城里的应当出来；在乡下的不要进城；
21.en: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

21.zh: 因为这是报应的日子，使[经上]所写的都得应验。
21.en: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

21.zh: 当那些日子，怀孕的和奶孩子的有祸了！因为将有大灾难降在这地方，也有震怒临到这百姓。
21.en: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

21.zh: 他们要倒在刀下，又被掳到各国去。耶路撒冷要被外邦人践踏，直到外邦人的日期满了。」
21.en: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

21.zh: 「日、月、星辰要显出异兆，地上的邦国也有困苦；因海中波浪的响声，就慌慌不定。
21.en: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

21.zh: 天势都要震动，人想起那将要临到世界的事，就都吓得魂不附体。
21.en: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

21.zh: 那时，他们要看见人子有能力，有大荣耀驾云降临。
21.en: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

21.zh: 一有这些事，你们就当挺身昂首，因为你们得赎的日子近了。」
21.en: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

21.zh: 耶稣又设比喻对他们说：「你们看无花果树和各样的树；它发芽的时候，你们一看见，自然晓得夏天近了。
21.en: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.
When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

21.zh: 这样，你们看见这些事渐渐地成就，也该晓得　神的国近了。
21.en: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

21.zh: 我实在告诉你们，这世代还没有过去，这些事都要成就。
21.en: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

21.zh: 天地要废去，我的话却不能废去。」
21.en: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

21.zh: 「你们要谨慎，恐怕因贪食、醉酒，并今生的思虑累住你们的心，那日子就如同网罗忽然临到你们；
21.en: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

21.zh: 因为那日子要[这样]临到全地上一切居住的人。
21.en: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

21.zh: 你们要时时警醒，常常祈求，使你们能逃避这一切要来的事，得以站立在人子面前。」
21.en: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

21.zh: 耶稣每日在殿里教训人，每夜出城在一座山，名叫橄榄山住宿。
21.en: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

21.zh: 众百姓清早上[圣]殿，到耶稣那里，要听他讲道。
21.en: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

22.zh: 除酵节（又名逾越[节]）近了。
22.en: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

22.zh: 祭司长和文士想法子怎么才能杀害耶稣，是因他们惧怕百姓。
22.en: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

22.zh: 这时，撒但入了那称为加略人犹大的心；他本是十二门徒里的一个。
22.en: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

22.zh: 他去和祭司长并守殿官商量，怎么可以把耶稣交给他们。
22.en: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

22.zh: 他们欢喜，就约定给他银子。
22.en: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

22.zh: 他应允了，就找机会，要趁众人不在跟前的时候把耶稣交给他们。
22.en: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

22.zh: 除酵[节]，须宰逾越[羊羔]的那一天到了。
22.en: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

22.zh: 耶稣打发彼得、约翰，说：「你们去为我们预备逾越[节的筵席]，好叫我们吃。」
22.en: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

22.zh: 他们问他说：「要我们在哪里预备？」
22.en: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

22.zh: 耶稣说：「你们进了城，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而来，你们就跟着他，到他所进的房子里去，
22.en: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

22.zh: 对那家的主人说：『夫子说：客房在哪里？我与门徒好在那里吃逾越[节的筵席]。』
22.en: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

22.zh: 他必指给你们摆设整齐的一间大楼，你们就在那里预备。」
22.en: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

22.zh: 他们去了，所遇见的正如耶稣所说的；他们就预备了逾越[节的筵席]。
22.en: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

22.zh: 时候到了，耶稣坐席，使徒也和他同坐。
22.en: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

22.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「我很愿意在受害以先和你们吃这逾越[节的筵席]。
22.en: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

22.zh: 我告诉你们，我不[再]吃[这筵席]，直到成就在　神的国里。」
22.en: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

22.zh: 耶稣接过杯来，祝谢了，说：「你们拿这个，大家分着喝。
22.en: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

22.zh: 我告诉你们，从今以后，我不再喝这葡萄汁，直等　神的国来到。」
22.en: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

22.zh: 又拿起饼来，祝谢了，就擘开，递给他们，说：「这是我的身体，为你们舍的，你们也应当如此行，为的是记念我。」
22.en: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

22.zh: 饭后也照样拿起杯来，说：「这杯是用我血所立的新约，是为你们流出来的。
22.en: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

22.zh: 看哪，那卖我之人的手与我一同在桌子上。
22.en: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

22.zh: 人子固然要照所预定的去世，但卖人子的人有祸了！」
22.en: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

22.zh: 他们就彼此对问，是哪一个要做这事。
22.en: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

22.zh: 门徒起了争论，他们中间哪一个可算为大。
22.en: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

22.zh: 耶稣说：「外邦人有君王为主治理他们，那掌权管他们的称为恩主。
22.en: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

22.zh: 但你们不可这样；你们里头为大的，倒要像年幼的，为首领的，倒要像服事人的。
22.en: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

22.zh: 是谁为大？是坐席的呢？是服事人的呢？不是坐席的大吗？然而，我在你们中间如同服事人的。
22.en: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

22.zh: 我在磨炼之中，常和我同在的就是你们。
22.en: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

22.zh: 我将国赐给你们，正如我父赐给我一样，
22.en: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

22.zh: 叫你们在我国里，坐在我的席上吃喝，并且坐在宝座上，审判以色列十二个支派。」
22.en: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

22.zh: [主又说]：「西门！西门！撒但想要得着你们，好筛你们像筛麦子一样；
22.en: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

22.zh: 但我已经为你祈求，叫你不至于失了信心。你回头以后，要坚固你的弟兄。」
22.en: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”
