22.zh: 彼得说：「主啊，我就是同你下监，同你受死，也是甘心！」
22.en: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

22.zh: 耶稣说：「彼得，我告诉你，今日鸡还没有叫，你要三次说不认得我。」
22.en: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

22.zh: 耶稣又对他们说：「我差你们出去的时候，没有钱囊，没有口袋，没有鞋，你们缺少什么没有？」他们说：「没有。」
22.en: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

22.zh: 耶稣说：「但如今有钱囊的可以带着，有口袋的也可以带着，没有刀的要卖衣服买刀。
22.en: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

22.zh: 我告诉你们，[经上]写着说：『他被列在罪犯之中。』这话必应验在我身上，因为那关系我的事必然成就。」
22.en: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

22.zh: 他们说：「主啊，请看！这里有两把刀。」耶稣说：「够了。」
22.en: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

22.zh: 耶稣出来，照常往橄榄山去，门徒也跟随他。
22.en: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

22.zh: 到了那地方，就对他们说：「你们要祷告，免得入了迷惑。」
22.en: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

22.zh: 于是离开他们约有扔一块石头那么远，跪下祷告，
22.en: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

22.zh: 说：「父啊！你若愿意，就把这杯撤去；然而，不要成就我的意思，只要成就你的意思。」
22.en: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

22.zh: 有一位天使从天上显现，加添他的力量。
22.en: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

22.zh: 耶稣极其伤痛，祷告更加恳切，汗珠如大血点滴在地上。
22.en: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

22.zh: 祷告完了，就起来，到门徒那里，见他们因为忧愁都睡着了，
22.en: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

22.zh: 就对他们说：「你们为什么睡觉呢？起来祷告，免得入了迷惑！」
22.en: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

22.zh: 说话之间，来了许多人。那十二个门徒里名叫犹大的，走在前头，就近耶稣，要与他亲嘴。
22.en: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

22.zh: 耶稣对他说：「犹大！你用亲嘴[的暗号]卖人子吗？」
22.en: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

22.zh: 左右的人见光景不好，就说：「主啊！我们拿刀砍可以不可以？」
22.en: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

22.zh: 内中有一个人把大祭司的仆人砍了一刀，削掉了他的右耳。
22.en: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

22.zh: 耶稣说：「到了这个地步，由他们吧！」就摸那人的耳朵，把他治好了。
22.en: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

22.zh: 耶稣对那些来拿他的祭司长和守殿官并长老说：「你们带着刀棒出来拿我，如同拿强盗吗？
22.en: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

22.zh: 我天天同你们在殿里，你们不下手拿我。现在却是你们的时候，黑暗掌权了。」
22.en: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

22.zh: 他们拿住耶稣，把他带到大祭司的宅里。彼得远远地跟着。
22.en: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

22.zh: 他们在院子里生了火，一同坐着；彼得也坐在他们中间。
22.en: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

22.zh: 有一个使女看见彼得坐在[火]光里，就定睛看他，说：「这个人素来也是同那人一伙的。」
22.en: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

22.zh: 彼得却不承认，说：「女子，我不认得他。」
22.en: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

22.zh: 过了不多的时候，又有一个人看见他，说：「你也是他们一党的。」彼得说：「你这个人！我不是。」
22.en: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

22.zh: 约过了一小时，又有一个人极力地说：「他实在是同那人一伙的，因为他也是加利利人。」
22.en: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

22.zh: 彼得说：「你这个人！我不晓得你说的是什么！」正说话之间，鸡就叫了。
22.en: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

22.zh: 主转过身来看彼得，彼得便想起主对他所说的话：「今日鸡叫以先，你要三次不认我。」
22.en: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

22.zh: 他就出去痛哭。
22.en: He went out, and wept bitterly.

22.zh: 看守耶稣的人戏弄他，打他，
22.en: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

22.zh: 又蒙着他的眼，问他说：「你是先知，告诉我们打你的是谁？」
22.en: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

22.zh: 他们还用许多别的话辱骂他。
22.en: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

22.zh: 天一亮，民间的众长老连祭司长带文士都聚会，把耶稣带到他们的公会里，
22.en: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

22.zh: 说：「你若是基督，就告诉我们。」耶稣说：「我若告诉你们，你们也不信；
22.en: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

22.zh: 我若问你们，你们也不回答。
22.en: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

22.zh: 从今以后，人子要坐在　神权能的右边。」
22.en: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

22.zh: 他们都说：「这样，你是　神的儿子吗？」耶稣说：「你们所说的是。」
22.en: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

22.zh: 他们说：「何必再用见证呢？他亲口所说的，我们都亲自听见了。」
22.en: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

23.zh: 众人都起来，把耶稣解到彼拉多面前，
23.en: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

23.zh: 就告他说：「我们见这人诱惑国民，禁止纳税给凯撒，并说自己是基督，是王。」
23.en: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

23.zh: 彼拉多问耶稣说：「你是犹太人的王吗？」耶稣回答说：「你说的是。」
23.en: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

23.zh: 彼拉多对祭司长和众人说：「我查不出这人有什么罪来。」
23.en: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

23.zh: 但他们越发极力地说：「他煽惑百姓，在犹太遍地传道，从加利利起，直到这里了。」
23.en: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

23.zh: 彼拉多一听见，就问：「这人是加利利人吗？」
23.en: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

23.zh: 既晓得耶稣属希律所管，就把他送到希律那里去。那时希律正在耶路撒冷。
23.en: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

23.zh: 希律看见耶稣，就很欢喜；因为听见过他的事，久已想要见他，并且指望看他行一件神迹，
23.en: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

23.zh: 于是问他许多的话，耶稣却一言不答。
23.en: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

23.zh: 祭司长和文士都站着，极力地告他。
23.en: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

23.zh: 希律和他的兵丁就藐视耶稣，戏弄他，给他穿上华丽衣服，把他送回彼拉多那里去。
23.en: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

23.zh: 从前希律和彼拉多彼此有仇，在那一天就成了朋友。
23.en: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

23.zh: 彼拉多传齐了祭司长和官府并百姓，
23.en: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

23.zh: 就对他们说：「你们解这人到我这里，说他是诱惑百姓的。看哪，我也曾将你们告他的事，在你们面前审问他，并没有查出他什么罪来；
23.en: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

23.zh: 就是希律也是如此，所以把他送回来。可见他没有做什么该死的事。
23.en: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

23.zh: 故此，我要责打他，把他释放了。」
23.en: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”
Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

23.zh: 众人却一齐喊着说：「除掉这个人！释放巴拉巴给我们！」
23.en: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

23.zh: 这巴拉巴是因在城里作乱杀人，下在监里的。
23.en: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

23.zh: 彼拉多愿意释放耶稣，就又劝解他们。
23.en: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

23.zh: 无奈他们喊着说：「钉他十字架！钉他十字架！」
23.en: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

23.zh: 彼拉多第三次对他们说：「为什么呢？这人做了什么恶事呢？我并没有查出他什么该死的罪来。所以，我要责打他，把他释放了。」
23.en: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

23.zh: 他们大声催逼彼拉多，求他把耶稣钉在十字架上。他们的声音就得了胜。
23.en: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

23.zh: 彼拉多这才照他们所求的定案，
23.en: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

23.zh: 把他们所求的那作乱杀人、下在监里的释放了，把耶稣交给他们，任凭他们的意思行。
23.en: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

23.zh: 带耶稣去的时候，有一个古利奈人西门，从乡下来；他们就抓住他，把十字架搁在他身上，叫他背着跟随耶稣。
23.en: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

23.zh: 有许多百姓跟随耶稣，内中有好些妇女；妇女们为他号咷痛哭。
23.en: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

23.zh: 耶稣转身对她们说：「耶路撒冷的女子，不要为我哭，当为自己和自己的儿女哭。
23.en: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

23.zh: 因为日子要到，人必说：『不生育的，和未曾怀胎的，未曾乳养婴孩的，有福了！』
23.en: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

23.zh: 那时，人要向大山说： 倒在我们身上！ 向小山说： 遮盖我们！
23.en: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

23.zh: 「这些事既行在有汁水的树上，那枯干的树将来怎么样呢？」
23.en: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

23.zh: 又有两个犯人，和耶稣一同带来处死。
23.en: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

23.zh: 到了一个地方，名叫「髑髅地」，就在那里把耶稣钉在十字架上，又钉了两个犯人：一个在左边，一个在右边。
23.en: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

23.zh: 当下耶稣说：「父啊！赦免他们；因为他们所做的，他们不晓得。」[兵丁]就拈阄分他的衣服。
23.en: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

23.zh: 百姓站在那里观看。官府也嗤笑他，说：「他救了别人；他若是基督，　神所拣选的，可以救自己吧！」
23.en: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

23.zh: 兵丁也戏弄他，上前拿醋送给他喝，
23.en: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

23.zh: 说：「你若是犹太人的王，可以救自己吧！」
23.en: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

23.zh: 在耶稣以上有一个牌子写着：「这是犹太人的王。」
23.en: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

23.zh: 那同钉的两个犯人有一个讥笑他，说：「你不是基督吗？可以救自己和我们吧！」
23.en: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

23.zh: 那一个就应声责备他，说：「你既是一样受刑的，还不怕　神吗？
23.en: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

23.zh: 我们是应该的，因我们所受的与我们所做的相称，但这个人没有做过一件不好的事。」
23.en: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

23.zh: 就说：「耶稣啊，你得国降临的时候，求你记念我！」
23.en: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

23.zh: 耶稣对他说：「我实在告诉你，今日你要同我在乐园里了。」
23.en: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

23.zh: 那时约有午正，遍地都黑暗了，直到申初，
23.en: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

23.zh: 日头变黑了；殿里的幔子从当中裂为两半。
23.en: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

23.zh: 耶稣大声喊着说：「父啊！我将我的灵魂交在你手里。」说了这话，气就断了。
23.en: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

23.zh: 百夫长看见所成的事，就归荣耀与　神，说：「这真是个义人！」
23.en: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

23.zh: 聚集观看的众人见了这所成的事都捶着胸回去了。
23.en: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

23.zh: 还有一切与耶稣熟识的人，和从加利利跟着他来的妇女们，都远远地站着看这些事。
23.en: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

23.zh: 有一个人名叫约瑟，是个议士，为人善良公义；
23.en: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

23.zh: 众人所谋所为，他并没有附从。他本是犹太、亚利马太城里素常盼望　神国的人。
23.en: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

23.zh: 这人去见彼拉多，求耶稣的身体，
23.en: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

23.zh: 就取下来，用细麻布裹好，安放在石头凿成的坟墓里；那里头从来没有葬过人。
23.en: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

23.zh: 那日是预备日，安息日也快到了。
23.en: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

23.zh: 那些从加利利和耶稣同来的妇女跟在后面，看见了坟墓和他的身体怎样安放。
23.en: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

23.zh: 她们就回去，预备了香料香膏。她们在安息日，便遵着诫命安息了。
23.en: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

24.zh: 七日的头一日，黎明的时候，那些妇女带着所预备的香料来到坟墓前，
24.en: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

24.zh: 看见石头已经从坟墓滚开了，
24.en: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

24.zh: 她们就进去，只是不见主耶稣的身体。
24.en: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

24.zh: 正在猜疑之间，忽然有两个人站在旁边，衣服放光。
24.en: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

24.zh: 妇女们惊怕，将脸伏地。那两个人就对她们说：「为什么在死人中找活人呢？
24.en: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

24.zh: 他不在这里，已经复活了。当记念他还在加利利的时候怎样告诉你们，
24.en: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

24.zh: 说：『人子必须被交在罪人手里，钉在十字架上，第三日复活。』」
24.en: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

24.zh: 她们就想起耶稣的话来，
24.en: They remembered his words,

24.zh: 便从坟墓那里回去，把这一切的事告诉十一个使徒和其余的人。
24.en: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

24.zh: 那告诉使徒的就是抹大拉的马利亚和约亚拿，并雅各的母亲马利亚，还有与她们在一处的妇女。
24.en: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

24.zh: 她们这些话，使徒以为是胡言，就不相信。
24.en: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

24.zh: 彼得起来，跑到坟墓前，低头往里看，见细麻布独在一处，就回去了，心里希奇所成的事。
24.en: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

24.zh: 正当那日，门徒中有两个人往一个村子去；这村子名叫以马忤斯，离耶路撒冷约有二十五里。
24.en: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

24.zh: 他们彼此谈论所遇见的这一切事。
24.en: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

24.zh: 正谈论相问的时候，耶稣亲自就近他们，和他们同行；
24.en: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

24.zh: 只是他们的眼睛迷糊了，不认识他。
24.en: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

24.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「你们走路彼此谈论的是什么事呢？」他们就站住，脸上带着愁容。
24.en: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

24.zh: 二人中有一个名叫革流巴的回答说：「你在耶路撒冷作客，还不知道这几天在那里所出的事吗？」
24.en: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

24.zh: 耶稣说：「什么事呢？」他们说：「就是拿撒勒人耶稣的事。他是个先知，在　神和众百姓面前，说话行事都有大能。
24.en: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

24.zh: 祭司长和我们的官府竟把他解去，定了死罪，钉在十字架上。
24.en: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

24.zh: 但我们素来所盼望、要赎以色列民的就是他！不但如此，而且这事成就，现在已经三天了。
24.en: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

24.zh: 再者，我们中间有几个妇女使我们惊奇；她们清早到了坟墓那里，
24.en: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

24.zh: 不见他的身体，就回来告诉我们，说看见了天使显现，说他活了。
24.en: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

24.zh: 又有我们的几个人往坟墓那里去，所遇见的正如妇女们所说的，只是没有看见他。」
24.en: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

24.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「无知的人哪，先知所说的一切话，你们的心信得太迟钝了。
24.en: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

24.zh: 基督这样受害，又进入他的荣耀，岂不是应当的吗？」
24.en: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

24.zh: 于是从摩西和众先知起，凡经上所指着自己的话都给他们讲解明白了。
24.en: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

24.zh: 将近他们所去的村子，耶稣好像还要往前行，
24.en: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

24.zh: 他们却强留他，说：「时候晚了，日头已经平西了，请你同我们住下吧！」耶稣就进去，要同他们住下。
24.en: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

24.zh: 到了坐席的时候，耶稣拿起饼来，祝谢了，擘开，递给他们。
24.en: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

24.zh: 他们的眼睛明亮了，这才认出他来。忽然耶稣不见了。
24.en: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

24.zh: 他们彼此说：「在路上，他和我们说话，给我们讲解圣经的时候，我们的心岂不是火热的吗？」
24.en: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

24.zh: 他们就立时起身，回耶路撒冷去，正遇见十一个使徒和他们的同人聚集在一处，
24.en: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

24.zh: 说：「主果然复活，已经现给西门看了。」
24.en: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

24.zh: 两个人就把路上[所遇见]，和擘饼的时候怎么被他们认出来的事，都述说了一遍。
24.en: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

24.zh: 正说这话的时候，耶稣亲自站在他们当中，说：「愿你们平安！」
24.en: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

24.zh: 他们却惊慌害怕，以为所看见的是魂。
24.en: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

24.zh: 耶稣说：「你们为什么愁烦？为什么心里起疑念呢？
24.en: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

24.zh: 你们看我的手，我的脚，就[知道]实在是我了。摸我看看！魂无骨无肉，你们看，我是有的。」
24.en: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

24.zh: 说了这话，就把手和脚给他们看。
24.en: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

24.zh: 他们正喜得不敢信，并且希奇；耶稣就说：「你们这里有什么吃的没有？」
24.en: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

24.zh: 他们便给他一片烧鱼。
24.en: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

24.zh: 他接过来，在他们面前吃了。
24.en: He took them, and ate in front of them.

24.zh: 耶稣对他们说：「这就是我从前与你们同在之时所告诉你们的话说：摩西的律法、先知的书，和诗篇上所记的，凡指着我的话都必须应验。」
24.en: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

24.zh: 于是耶稣开他们的心窍，使他们能明白圣经，
24.en: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

24.zh: 又对他们说：「照[经上]所写的，基督必受害，第三日从死里复活，
24.en: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

24.zh: 并且人要奉他的名传悔改、赦罪的道，从耶路撒冷起直传到万邦。
24.en: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

24.zh: 你们就是这些事的见证。
24.en: You are witnesses of these things.

24.zh: 我要将我父所应许的降在你们身上，你们要在城里等候，直到你们领受从上头来的能力。」
24.en: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

24.zh: 耶稣领他们到伯大尼的对面，就举手给他们祝福。
24.en: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

24.zh: 正祝福的时候，他就离开他们，被带到天上去了。
24.en: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

24.zh: 他们就拜他，大大地欢喜，回耶路撒冷去，
24.en: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

24.zh: 常在殿里称颂　神。
24.en: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
